items.title: Report: Vegas NBA expansion team debut may be delayed a year
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The NBA's roll of the dice in Las Vegas could be delayed a year later than expected, with an expansion team potentially looking at a debut for the 2029-30 season, The Athletic reported Friday.
items.body:
The NBA's roll of the dice in Las Vegas could be delayed a year later than expected, with an expansion team potentially looking at a debut for the 2029-30 season, The Athletic reported Friday.
Previous reports indicated a Las Vegas expansion team could be ready to take the floor in the 2028-29 campaign, along with another expansion team in Seattle.
Earlier this week, ESPN reported that the league was reviewing bids for a Las Vegas expansion team from three potential ownership groups in Nancy Walton Laurie and Bill Laurie; Steve Apostolopoulos and Marc Lasry; and Bill Foley and Jerry Colangelo.
Friday's report indicated that Las Vegas' 2028-29 debut has not been completely ruled out.
While the NBA would like to have an expansion plan finalized by the end of December, a decision on the ownership group of the Las Vegas franchise could come by the end of November. The two bidding groups not chosen for the Las Vegas franchise could be welcomed into the bidding for the Seattle franchise.
Also to be decided is whether the Las Vegas expansion team will call the existing T-Mobile Arena its home or if a new arena would be built. The existing venue is home to the NHL's Vegas Golden Knights but would need an upgrade worth as much as $400 million to meet NBA standards, according to the report.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Two Iranians charged in UK over alleged terrorism plot targeting Jewish community
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: British police said on Friday that they had charged two Iranian nationals with preparing a terrorist attack against the Jewish community in northern England on the eve of Yom Kippur, the holiest day in the Jewish calendar.
items.body:
British police said on Friday that they had charged two Iranian nationals with preparing a terrorist attack against the Jewish community in northern England on the eve of Yom Kippur, the holiest day in the Jewish calendar.
Rahman Salehi, 35, and Salam Ahmadyan, 36, have been charged with preparing to commit an act of terrorism or assisting another to commit at act of terrorism on Friday, the anniversary of a [USN:L5N3VP15G TEXT:"fatal attack"] on a Manchester synagogue last year.
The two men had allegedly been in contact with an overseas third-party who might be in Iran in relation to the plot, police said. The pair will appear at London's Westminster Magistrates' Court on Saturday.
Counter terrorism detectives said there was no connection with a separate suspected plot involving the RAF Fairford air base used by the US to target Iran, over which a dual UK-Iranian national was [USN:L1N45N0TX TEXT:"arrested on Thursday"].
Vicki Evans from Counter Terrorism Policing (CTP) said in a statement: "While this incident and the investigation into the RAF Fairford incident are not connected in any way, I want to reassure the public that CTP, working with our national security partners, are using the full range of our capabilities to protect the UK from any hostile acts."

items.title: Community banks sue US regulator over crypto firm charters
items.author: Pete Schroeder
items.creator: Pete Schroeder
items.summary: A trade organization representing community banks sued a US bank regulator Friday, claiming that its decision to grant limited bank charters to cryptocurrency firms exceeds its regulatory authority.
items.body:
A trade organization representing community banks sued a US bank regulator Friday, claiming that its decision to grant limited bank charters to cryptocurrency firms exceeds its regulatory authority.
The Independent Community Bankers of America, which represents banks that typically have less than $10 billion in assets, filed the suit in the US District Court for the District of Columbia.
The group said the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency must revoke a recent rule and related guidance smoothing the way for crypto firms to apply for national trust bank charters. The group argued the move grants legitimacy to crypto firms without sufficient safeguards.
"American consumers reasonably expect a federally chartered bank to carry federal protections. Digital assets held at a crypto firm operating under a national trust charter do not carry those important safeguards. ICBA is asking the court to return the OCC to its statutory limits. Any non-fiduciary firm seeking the benefits of a federal bank charter should meet the same standards as community banks," said ICBA President and CEO Rebecca Romero Rainey in a statement.
An OCC spokesperson declined to comment.
Under President Donald Trump, the regulator has granted several such charters to firms primarily engaging in crypto activities and other fintechs. The national trust bank charters allow companies to manage and hold assets on behalf of customers and settle payments faster. The license does not, however, allow the companies to take cash deposits or make loans.
But ICBA argued in its lawsuit that granting such charters exceeds the regulator's authority and Congress' intent, while arguing traditional banks must adhere to stricter regulatory requirements and oversight under their charters.

items.title: 49ers owner Jed York suspended 6 games, fined $500K by NFL
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: San Francisco 49ers principal owner Jed York has been suspended for six games and fined $500,000 for violating the NFL's personal conduct policy, the league announced Friday.
items.body:
San Francisco 49ers principal owner Jed York has been suspended for six games and fined $500,000 for violating the NFL's personal conduct policy, the league announced Friday.
York, 46, originally was charged in August with two misdemeanors: engaging in prostitution and possession of criminal tools. The prostitution charge later was amended to disorderly conduct as part of his no-contest plea agreement.
Per the NFL, York is credited with serving three of those games by virtue of steering clear of the 49ers during the league's investigation. He will serve the next three and is eligible to return on Tuesday, Oct. 20.
"Today, the NFL concluded its review, and I accept its decision in full," York said in a statement. "To my family, to the players, coaches, and employees of the San Francisco 49ers, to our fans and partners, I am deeply sorry.
"This was an inexcusable mistake and I take full responsibility. What I did does not reflect my values or the man I strive to be for my family.
"While I fell short of the model I want to set for my sons, I now hope to show them the importance of owning up to one's failures, and that even our worst moments teach us to be better. Leading the 49ers is a privilege, and one I don't take lightly. Your trust will have to be earned back over time, and I look forward to that work ahead."
The 49ers are off to a 3-0 start this season.
York, a native of Youngstown, Ohio, was the 49ers' CEO until February and has been the team's principal owner since 2024.
--Field Level Media

items.title: US FDA closes lettuce parasite probe, links outbreak to Mexico facility
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The US FDA said on Friday it has concluded its investigation into a summer parasite outbreak, linking the illnesses to recalled shredded iceberg lettuce from Taylor Farms de Mexico.
items.body:
The US FDA said on Friday it has concluded its investigation into a summer parasite outbreak, linking the illnesses to recalled shredded iceberg lettuce from Taylor Farms de Mexico.
While investigators could not definitively determine how the contamination happened, tests confirmed the cyclospora parasite was present in the environment where the lettuce was grown and processed, the regulator said.
During the probe, investigators found the parasite at Taylor Farms de Mexico's processing facility and at a lettuce farm in Mexico.
Two samples collected during inspections in Mexico tested positive for cyclospora, the regulator said.
One sample came from a tank that held outgoing wastewater from Taylor Farms de Mexico's processing facility, while the other came from a drainage ditch at an iceberg lettuce grower identified in the US Food and Drug Administration's traceback investigation.
Taylor Farms de Mexico did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment.
Patient illness reports and supply-chain tracking strongly supported the link between the recalled lettuce and the multistate outbreak, which caused intestinal sickness, the FDA said.
Genetic testing of both positive samples is complete, and the regulator is still analyzing how the results compare with ongoing testing of samples from patients.
The FDA also announced a 10-point plan to prevent similar outbreaks ahead of the 2027 growing season.
The actions include more monitoring of produce historically linked to the parasite, more outreach to growers and an outbreak investigation report with prevention recommendations.
The US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention declared the outbreak over on September 11.
As of September 14, the CDC had received reports of 19,883 laboratory-confirmed cases of cyclosporiasis and two deaths.

items.title: Another oilsands boom? Smith, Carney say this time Canada will be ready
items.author: The Canadian Press
items.summary: The federal and provincial governments believe a new West Coast pipeline coupled with policy shifts might help turn up the volume.
items.body: CALGARY — It’s been a relatively quiet decade in Alberta’s oilsands, but the federal and provincial governments believe a new West Coast pipeline coupled with policy shifts might help turn up the volume. Prime Minister Mark Carney was in Fort McMurray, Alta., this week to announce the first proposal to be deemed in the national interest under legislation passed last year: the million-barrel-per-day Pacific Link pipeline from Alberta to a tanker export terminal in southern B.C. The designation means the proposal will be subject to a streamlined review process, shepherded by the Calgary-based major projects office. The pipeline’s economic fate hinges on oilsands companies being willing to spend on expanding their output. At a news conference, Carney was asked whether he expected a return to boom times in the northeastern Alberta oilsands hub city. “I wouldn’t use the term ‘boom,’” he replied. “I would use ‘sustained growth.’” The last boom from the mid-2000s to mid-2010s came with the side-effects of cost inflation, labour scarcity and housing shortages. Carney and Alberta Premier Danielle Smith say that if oilsands companies start building again — as they hope — it will be different this time around. Oilsands companies have for years shied away from the multibillion-dollar megaprojects of more than a decade ago. The last mine to be built from scratch was Fort Hills, operated by Suncor Energy Inc. From when it got the final go-ahead decision in 2013 to its startup in 2018, its cost ballooned to more than $17 billion from $13.5 billion. Lately, instead of so-called “green field” projects, companies have opted to instead tweak their existing operations to squeeze out more bitumen or add to their existing footprints. Executives have cited a dearth of pipeline capacity, a convoluted regulatory regime and onerous environmental regulations for the chill on large-scale growth projects. But also around the time investment fell off a decade ago, global crude prices cratered amid a supply glut and didn’t have much of a chance to recover before the COVID-19 pandemic virtually obliterated demand. Fast forward to 2026, and the Mideast war has laid bare the vulnerability of global energy supply chains and left countries clamouring for stable providers. A host of Trudeau-era energy policies loathed by oilpatch players have been undone and Pacific Link has taken a big step forward to becoming a reality, potentially enabling more oilsands crude to reach lucrative Asian markets. “We learned lessons from the past in building infrastructure,” Carney told reporters on Thursday. He said local mayors are thinking ahead for what their communities need and early participation from First Nations leaders means “a much broader spread of the economic benefits.” He also cited “another phase of technical innovation” in the industry that didn’t exist previously. At the news conference, Smith noted the autonomous oilsands haul trucks in the backdrop. Previously, human drivers for those gargantuan vehicles would have received six-figure salaries and might have been flown in and out of the site from elsewhere in Canada, living in work camps, for a week or two at a time. “(Companies) have managed to find a way to increase production without having the kind of dramatic pressure that we saw in the past of a large number of people moving here, not able to find homes,” Smith said. The premier said she’s also talked to local municipal leaders about the bridge and road infrastructure that might be needed if production ramps up. She mentioned upgrades to Highway 881, the road that winds through several steam-driven oilsands sites south of Fort McMurray, Alta. “There’s lots of ways that we can partner with the federal government to make sure those key infrastructure projects get built, so we build on a pace that allows us to keep up,” she said. Andrew Botterill, who leads Deloitte Canada’s oil, gas and chemicals practice, said the Alberta oilpatch has matured since the last boom. “What we have is a more efficient, far more aligned group of producers up there than maybe what it was 10, 15 years ago,” he said. “They’ve come together as an alliance and really recognize that ‘We’ve got to share labour, we’ve got to be less competitive, we’ve got to find ways that we can do things together and not just drive up costs.’” Oilsands properties are concentrated in fewer hands than had been the case a decade or more ago. Erstwhile producers including Husky and MEG Energy have been bought out and international players like Shell and Total have exited or sharply reduced their holdings. Lance Mortlock managing partner at EY Canada, flagged a bigger-picture concern over the availability of workers with multiple major projects in the works — not just the Pacific Link pipeline and new oilsands projects, but potentially mines, transmission lines and hydro dams. “We’re going to need tens of thousands of workers across the country to build this stuff: engineers, professionals, welders, pipe fitters. I’m not sure where all these people are going to come from if we do half the projects that we have the desire to construct,” he said. “So I’m hoping that there’s going to be more conversation about the workforce and more conversation about how do we sequence these things so we optimize the system from a labour force perspective?” --- Lauren Krugel, The Canadian Press This report by The Canadian Press was first published Oct. 2, 2026.
items.raw_description: The federal and provincial governments believe a new West Coast pipeline coupled with policy shifts might help turn up the volume.

items.title: Área de producción de oro aluvial de Colombia crece en 2025 por tercer año consecutivo: informe
items.author: Luis Jaime Acosta
items.creator: Luis Jaime Acosta
items.summary: La superficie con explotación de oro de aluvión en Colombia creció un 4,5% interanual en 2025 y alcanzó un récord de 118.410 hectáreas, impulsada por la expansión de la actividad en tierras de comunidades negras, reveló el viernes un informe de la Oficina de las Naciones Unidas contra la Droga y el Delito (UNODC) y del Gobierno.
items.body:
La superficie con explotación de oro de aluvión en Colombia creció un 4,5% interanual en 2025 y alcanzó un récord de 118.410 hectáreas, impulsada por la expansión de la actividad en tierras de comunidades negras, reveló el viernes un informe de la Oficina de las Naciones Unidas contra la Droga y el Delito (UNODC) y del Gobierno.
El alza, de 5.100 hectáreas frente a las 113.310 de 2024, se registró en zonas con fuerte presencia de grupos armados ilegales. El país sudamericano completó en 2025 su tercer año consecutivo de aumento de la superficie explotada.
"El 75% es ilícita, el 21% cuenta con permisos técnicos y/o ambientales, y el 4% se encuentra en tránsito a la legalidad", indicó el informe.
El reporte señaló que 15 de los 32 departamentos del país registraron evidencias de explotación de oro de aluvión (EVOA) y que el 61% del aumento se produjo en tierras de comunidades negras. Asimismo, se detectó explotación en 30 resguardos indígenas.
De acuerdo con la UNODC, la mayor parte del oro en Colombia se encuentra en territorios habitados por comunidades negras, lo que explica el aumento de la explotación en esas zonas.
Las comunidades negras e indígenas han sido históricamente más vulnerables al conflicto armado, a la pobreza y al aislamiento en zonas rurales debido a la escasa presencia del Estado.
Casi la mitad de la explotación, 58.216 hectáreas, se encuentra en áreas donde la minería no está permitida, incluidas zonas de reserva forestal y parques nacionales naturales.
El número de municipios con esta actividad y presencia de al menos un grupo armado ilegal pasó de 114 en 2024 a 118 en 2025.
Además, 79 de los municipios con explotación de oro en 2025 tenían cultivos de coca, principalmente en los departamentos de Antioquia, Nariño, Cauca y Chocó.
Colombia vive un conflicto armado interno de más de seis décadas, que ha dejado alrededor de 450.000 muertos y en el que guerrillas izquierdistas y bandas criminales conformadas por antiguos paramilitares de derecha se enfrentan entre sí y con las Fuerzas Armadas del Estado.
La extracción ilícita de oro es la segunda fuente de financiación de los grupos armados ilegales, después del narcotráfico, según fuentes de seguridad.
La ministra de Minas y Energía, María Nohemí Arboleda, dijo, durante la presentación del informe, que la explotación ilícita de oro está destruyendo las selvas y contaminando los ríos con químicos.
"En casi la mitad del área con explotación de oro de aluvión hay también cultivos de coca. Es una mezcla, un negocio perfecto. Aquí no hay un debate sobre la minería: hay una confrontación entre el Estado y las economías criminales que usan el oro para financiar la violencia", afirmó Arboleda.
Arboleda aseguró que los países compradores de oro deben exigir trazabilidad para comprobar la legalidad del metal y dijo que el Estado debe llegar a los territorios afectados por la minería ilícita y quedarse.

items.title: DOJ will not reopen criminal probe into Fed's Powell, spokesperson says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The US Justice Department is not reopening a criminal probe into former Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell for cost overruns related to the central bank's building renovation project, a DOJ spokesperson said on Friday.
items.body:
The US Justice Department is not reopening a criminal probe into former Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell for cost overruns related to the central bank's building renovation project, a DOJ spokesperson said on Friday.
Attorney General Todd Blanche, in comments to Bloomberg News, which first reported the development, said he has not ruled out continuing to look into the project's oversight and potentially take action if evidence of wrongdoing came to light.
The Fed's [USN:L6N45M161 TEXT:"Inspector General on Wednesday"] said it found no grounds for a criminal referral or evidence of administrative misconduct tied to the project cost overruns, but its conclusion there was lax oversight drew a fresh call from President Donald Trump for Powell's resignation. Powell has remained at the Fed as a governor since stepping down as chair in May.
His successor Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh said on Thursday he would hire an independent auditor to "verify accuracy and compliance" for all of the project's costs.
Blanche told Bloomberg News that if this new review finds any evidence of criminal wrongdoing, the Justice Department could investigate.
At his final press conference as Fed chief in April, Powell said he would not leave the Board "until this investigation is well and truly over, with transparency and finality."
A Fed spokesperson had no immediate comment on Blanche's statements.
items.raw_description: The US Justice Department is not reopening a criminal probe into former Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell for cost overruns related to the central bank's building renovation project, a DOJ spokesperson said on Friday.

items.title: Un exdiputado de EEUU, condenado a 10 años de prisión por ejercer presión en favor de Venezuela
items.author: Luc Cohen
items.creator: Luc Cohen
items.summary: El legislador estadounidense David Rivera fue condenado el viernes a 10 años de prisión por hacer gestiones ilegales con funcionarios estadounidenses para que aliviaran la presión sobre el gobierno del derrocado presidente venezolano Nicolás Maduro.
items.body:
El legislador estadounidense David Rivera fue condenado el viernes a 10 años de prisión por hacer gestiones ilegales con funcionarios estadounidenses para que aliviaran la presión sobre el gobierno del derrocado presidente venezolano Nicolás Maduro.
Rivera, un republicano que representó al sur de Florida en la Cámara de Representantes de Estados Unidos entre 2011 y 2013, fue declarado culpable en mayo de haber ejercido presión sobre funcionarios estadounidenses en nombre de Venezuela en 2017 sin registrarse como lobista extranjero, tal y como exige la ley.
La sentencia fue dictada por la jueza federal de distrito Melissa Damian en una vista celebrada en un tribunal federal de Miami.
La Fiscalía de Estados Unidos en Miami había instado a Damian a imponer una "pena de prisión significativa".
Rivera, de 61 años, se declaró inocente, y sus abogados alegaron que no debería cumplir pena de prisión porque había estado trabajando para ayudar a la oposición venezolana a derrocar a Maduro, y no para beneficiar a su Gobierno.

items.title: Hackers Breached Propulsion System of US-Bound Oil Tanker
items.author: list.metadata.agency
items.summary: FBI and US Coast Guard investigators have found evidence that hackers accessed the propulsion system of an oil supertanker as it was approaching the Texas coast this summer, according to US officials familiar with the matter, an extraordinary breach that highlights the growing physical risks from cyberattacks.
items.body: (Bloomberg) -- FBI and US Coast Guard investigators have found evidence that hackers accessed the propulsion system of an oil supertanker as it was approaching the Texas coast this summer, according to US officials familiar with the matter, an extraordinary breach that highlights the growing physical risks from cyberattacks.The cyberattack resulted in outsiders gaining temporary access to the digital system on the ship, said the people, who asked not to be identified because they weren’t authorized to discuss the matter. Officials are still examining how the breach occurred and who was responsible. It wasn’t immediately clear how long the hackers had access and what they could’ve controlled aboard the ship with it.The breach of the tanker’s propulsion system, a rare and particularly invasive hack into a ship’s operations, underscores the urgency that led US authorities to board the VL Prosperity in August. The carrier — which is longer than the Chrysler Building is tall and as wide as an American football field — was fully-laden and bound for Galveston. The Coast Guard declined to comment. The FBI declined to answer questions beyond providing a statement the two agencies previously released about their joint boarding of the VL Prosperity and another ship “to ensure integrity of the vessel’s operational and information technology systems following indications that the networks of both vessels were compromised.”“Currently, there are no reports of operational disruptions, vessel instability, physical danger to crews, or environmental impacts,” the FBI said in the emailed statement. The prospect of unknown hackers potentially being able to remotely control the operational system of such a tanker, known as a Very Large Crude Carrier, has alarmed US military and intelligence officials. It highlights warnings about cyberattacks targeting the maritime sector, which have escalated in recent years with shipping vessels becoming increasingly dependent on network-linked systems for navigation, communications and other operations. Alex Soukhanov, whose firm True North Group works on maritime cybersecurity, said confirmed hacks of ships’ systems are rare but can have a huge impact.“These are the largest moving objects in the world transporting the world’s economy,” said Soukhanov, who is a licensed ship captain. “We just can’t have this type of unauthorized access. Every mariner should be extremely concerned.”In late August, a joint team of Coast Guard and FBI personnel boarded the VL Prosperity after it lost communications and authorities got indications that its network had been compromised by hackers, Bloomberg News previously reported. That month, the agencies also boarded another vessel in the Gulf of Mexico due to a suspected cyber threat.By September, US government agencies were tracking cyber threats against nearly 20 shipping vessels around the world, and the Coast Guard has asked for advance notice if any of those ships planned to come into a US port, Bloomberg previously reported.It would be the “worst case scenario” for a large vessel carrying hazardous material to lose some of its functions in a cyber attack, said Svante Einarsson, head of cyber security at ship technical advisory firm DNV. But, Einarsson added, most vessels have the ability to fall back on other systems that allow crews to to continue operations. The Prosperity remains anchored offshore Galveston, according to shipping data compiled by Bloomberg.--With assistance from Myles Miller and Lucia Kassai.More stories like this are available on bloomberg.com©2026 Bloomberg L.P.

items.title: Capa da Veja dizendo que Lula apoia "excluir Nossa Senhora Aparecida" é falsa
items.author: Reuters Fact Check
items.creator: Reuters Fact Check
items.summary: É falso que a revista Veja tenha publicado uma capa sobre um suposto projeto do PT para destituir Nossa Senhora Aparecida do posto de padroeira do Brasil com apoio do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, como dizem publicações nas redes sociais.
items.body:
É falso que a revista Veja tenha publicado uma capa sobre um suposto projeto do PT para destituir Nossa Senhora Aparecida do posto de padroeira do Brasil com apoio do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, como dizem publicações nas redes sociais.
"Projeto de lei de deputado petista, com apoio de Lula, visa excluir Nossa Senhora Aparecida e favorecer umbanda", diz a manchete da suposta edição de número 2.842, datada de 26 de setembro de 2026.
No entanto, a edição da Veja de data mais próxima é a de número 3.014, de 25 de setembro, que mostra na capa o presidente do Senado, Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP) e o ex-dono do Banco Master, Daniel Vorcaro.
A editora Abril, que publica a Veja, afirmou à Reuters que a imagem é falsa e que todas as capas oficiais podem ser verificadas no site da revista.
A campanha de Lula também disse que o conteúdo é falso. "O presidente Lula trata todas as religiões de forma igual e defende o exercício livre da fé", alegou em nota .
Uma pesquisa no site da Câmara dos Deputados não mostra uma proposta semelhante à dos posts entre as proposições em tramitação apresentadas por petistas na Casa.
O vice-presidente do Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE), ministro André Mendonça, determinou a retirada de quatro posts com a capa falsa do X. Segundo ele, a imagem não se apresenta como “simples opinião, crítica, sátira ou manifestação humorística” e “foi confeccionada para reproduzir a aparência de produto jornalístico real”.
A capa falsa mostra uma foto da primeira-dama Janja Lula da Silva vestida de branco ao lado de estátuas de orixás. A imagem foi originalmente postada no perfil de Janja no X em fevereiro de 2021.
A montagem circula dias após os rumores de que o candidato a presidente Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) pretende destituir Nossa Senhora Aparecida do título de padroeira do Brasil caso eleito, o que ele nega.
Desde então, a Reuters verificou conteúdos desinformativos ligados a questões religiosas e à campanha eleitoral.
(Este texto foi corrigido em 2 de outubro de 2026 para retificar o nome do partido de Flávio Bolsonaro.)
VEREDICTO Falso. É uma montagem a capa da revista Veja com uma foto de Janja e a manchete sobre uma proposta de um deputado do PT para “excluir” Nossa Senhora Aparecida em prol da umbanda.
Este artigo foi produzido pela equipe da Reuters Fact Check. Envie sugestões de checagem via WhatsApp pelo número (11) 91599-9278 . Leia mais sobre nosso trabalho de checagens de afirmações nas redes sociais aqui .

items.title: 米・ウクライナ復興基金、初の重要鉱物案件合意　レアアースなど鉱床開発
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Marc Jones

［ロンドン　２日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Marc Jones

［ロンドン　２日　ロイター］ - 米国とウクライナが共同で設立した「復興投資基金」は、重要鉱物分野で初となる案件を含む５件の新規プロジェクトで合意した。同基金の米政府高官が２日、ロイターに対し明らかにした。

復興投資基金はトランプ米大統領の働きかけを受けて２０２５年４月に両国が締結した「鉱物資源協定」の一環として設立されたもので、鉱物資源、防衛、エネルギー、インフラなど５つの戦略分野への投資に重点を置いている。復興投資基金を監督する米国際開発金融公社（ＤＦＣ）のコナー・コールマン投資責任者によると、基金が手掛ける案件の総額は約７０００万ドルに達した。

コールマン氏はロイターのインタビューに対し、投資案件はロシアによる全面侵攻を受けるウクライナに対する米国の支援を示しているとし、基金の投資余力を拡大するために新たな資金調達先を模索していると述べた。冬の到来を前にウクライナが継続的に被害にさらされていることに触れ、「現時点で投資することがウクライナ国民にとって極めて重要だ」と語った。

コールマン氏によると、初の重要鉱物案件はウクライナ最大のスーパーマーケットチェーン「ＡＴＢ」の共同所有者で富豪のゲンナジー・ブトケビッチ氏が設立したＢＧＶグループとの共同投資プラットフォームに約３０００万ドルを投じるもの。この共同投資プラットフォームはウクライナ国内の初期段階にある鉱山開発事業を対象にレアアース（希土類）、ウラン、ベリリウム、ジルコニウム鉱床の開発を進める。コールマン氏は「いずれも米国の重要鉱物リストに含まれており、米政権の優先課題とも整合的だ」と述べた。

この日に発表された他の新規案件のうち２件は、冬を前にロシアによる重要インフラ攻撃が増加する中、ウクライナの電力・暖房網の強化を目的としたもの。コールマン氏によるとこのうち１件は、ＤＦＣがウクライナ最大の民間エネルギー企業ＤＴＥＫに対し新たな蓄電システム向けとして決定した約１億ドルの融資を補完する。同蓄電システムは約６０万世帯に最大２時間のバックアップ電力を供給できるという。

復興投資基金はこのほか、損傷した電力・熱供給網の復旧を目的とする複数の「エネルギーハブ」の建設・運営を支援する熱電併給（コージェネレーション）プラットフォームにも出資する。

items.title: Nadia Lovell: Equities Must Earn the Next Leg Up
items.summary: As stocks rise and bond yields pull back ahead of the jobs report, Nadia Lovell of UBS says she remains bullish on equities, but believes the market’s next advance must be earned. The shift now extends beyond AI to investment in power, supply chains, and defense, broadening corporate profit opportunities. If these investments deliver a productivity boost, Lovell says, they could support a healthier market and further gains over the longer term. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Nigeria says domestic gas supply surpasses 2 billion cubic feet per day, eyes further growth
items.author: Camillus Eboh
items.creator: Camillus Eboh
items.summary: Nigeria's domestic gas supply has crossed 2 billion cubic feet per day (bcf/d), as the government pushes to expand supplies to power plants and industries and reduce constraints on economic growth, the country's gas minister said on Friday.
items.body:
Nigeria's domestic gas supply has crossed 2 billion cubic feet per day (bcf/d), as the government pushes to expand supplies to power plants and industries and reduce constraints on economic growth, the country's gas minister said on Friday.
Gas production rose to 7.5 bcf/d from about 6.8 bcf/d in 2023, Minister of State for Petroleum Resources (Gas) Ekperikpe Ekpo said. Proven gas reserves have increased to 215.19 trillion cubic feet (tcf) from 208.83 tcf, Ekpo said.
Nigeria is targeting gas production of 10 bcf/d by 2027 and 12 bcf/d by 2030 to meet growing demand from power generation, industry, fertiliser production, petrochemicals, liquefied natural gas (LNG), transportation and export markets.
To support higher domestic supply, the Obiafu-Obrikom-Oben (OB3) pipeline has reached full completion and is being prepared for first gas, Ekpo said. The pipeline can transport 2 bcf/d and is expected to unlock more than 500 million standard cubic feet per day (MMscf/d) of additional gas for the domestic market.
The Ajaokuta-Kaduna-Kano (AKK) pipeline is about 95% complete, he added.
Ekpo said 671 billion naira ($434 million) deployed through the Midstream and Downstream Gas Infrastructure Fund had attracted about 1.6 trillion naira in private investment across 31 projects and 205 infrastructure assets.
The projects are expected to deliver about 475 MMscf/d to the domestic market when fully operational. Nigeria is targeting about $30 billion in gas-sector investment by 2030.

items.title: Bayer to invest $2.2 billion in new US pharma site
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Bayer's pharmaceuticals unit on Friday unveiled plans to invest $2.2 billion in a new manufacturing site in New Albany, Ohio, part of a push to boost the business's US revenue.
items.body:
Bayer's pharmaceuticals unit on Friday unveiled plans to invest $2.2 billion in a new manufacturing site in New Albany, Ohio, part of a push to boost the business's US revenue.
Bayer expects to create about 600 high paying jobs in New Albany, with another 1,500 jobs resulting temporarily from construction.
The prescription drug unit of Germany's Bayer has increased the US share of global revenue to 35% from 20% in 2018 and it aims to double US sales by the end of the decade, said Sebastian Guth, chief operating officer for pharmaceuticals.
Among the main products to underpin the expansion are Kerendia to treat chronic kidney disease, prostate cancer drug Nubeqa as well as drug candidate asundexian to prevent strokes.
US prescription medicine prices are far higher than in other developed nations, and President Donald Trump has been pressuring drugmakers to lower their prices, while also demanding that other developed countries increase their prices.
"It is a very deliberate decision to strengthen our presence in the United States, alongside our historically strong presence in Europe and our strong presence in Asia," said Bayer Pharma's Guth.
A drug substance manufacturing site is set to become operational in 2031 with a site for finished drug product to follow in 2034.

items.title: Former US congressman sentenced to 10 years for secretly lobbying for Venezuela
items.author: Luc Cohen
items.creator: Luc Cohen
items.summary: Former US Congressman David Rivera was sentenced to 10 years in prison on Friday for illegally lobbying US officials to ease pressure on ousted Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro's government.
items.body:
Former US Congressman [USN:L6N41E0TG TEXT:"David Rivera"] was sentenced to 10 years in prison on Friday for illegally lobbying US officials to ease pressure on ousted Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro's government.
Rivera, a Republican who represented southern Florida in the US House of Representatives from 2011 to 2013, was [USN:L6N40B0RT TEXT:"convicted"] at trial in May of lobbying US officials on Venezuela's behalf in 2017 without registering as a foreign lobbyist as required by the Foreign Agents Registration Act (FARA).
The sentence was handed down by US District Judge Melissa Damian at a hearing in federal court in Miami.
Prosecutors with the Miami US Attorney's office had urged Damian to impose a "significant term of incarceration." They said Rivera acted on behalf of a "hostile foreign government" and was paid $20 million by the US subsidiary of Venezuela 's state oil company.
Rivera, 61, pleaded not guilty, and his lawyers said he should be spared prison time. They argued he had been working to help Venezuela's opposition remove Maduro from power, not benefit his government.
Rivera was charged in 2022, during Democratic President Joe Biden's administration, and defense lawyers noted that Republican President Donald Trump has deemphasized FARA cases since taking office in January 2025.

items.title: Codirector del Banco Central de Colombia considera necesario pensar en instrumentos diferentes a tasa de interés para reducir inflación
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Es necesario pensar en instrumentos diferentes a la tasa de interés para reducir la inflación, dijo el viernes el codirector del Banco Central de Colombia, César Giraldo, sin ofrecer más detalles.
items.body:
Es necesario pensar en instrumentos diferentes a la tasa de interés para reducir la inflación, dijo el viernes el codirector del Banco Central de Colombia, César Giraldo, sin ofrecer más detalles.
Los comentarios de Giraldo se registran dos días después de el que directorio del Banco Central decidió por mayoría incrementar su tasa de interés de referencia en 25 puntos base a un 12,25%, en busca de contener las presiones inflacionarias, en una decisión que sorprendió a la mayoría del mercado que esperaba que la mantuviera estable.
"La tasa de interés lleva dos años siendo altamente contraccionista en términos reales, es el país que más ha subido la tasa de interés en el mundo, 300 puntos básicos en lo que llevamos de un año y, si la inflación no ha cedido, es porque el instrumento está agotado", dijo Giraldo a Blu Radio.
"Entonces, yo creo que hay que pensar en otros instrumentos", aseguró.
En la reunión del miércoles, la decisión de subir la tasa referencial contó con el voto de cuatro de los siete miembros del directorio, mientras que dos se inclinaron por dejarla estable y uno por aumentarla en 50 puntos base.
La inflación en Colombia alcanzó al cierre de agosto un 6,24% anual, más del doble de la meta del Banco Central de 3% y amenaza con seguir subiendo por el eventual impacto del fenómeno climático de El Niño sobre los precios.

items.title: Vikings WR Justin Jefferson (ankle) out vs. Dolphins
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Minnesota Vikings wide receiver Justin Jefferson has been ruled out of Sunday's game versus the visiting Miami Dolphins due to a sprained ankle.
items.body:
Minnesota Vikings wide receiver Justin Jefferson has been ruled out of Sunday's game versus the visiting Miami Dolphins due to a sprained ankle.
Jefferson sustained the injury on a 10-yard reception in the first quarter of Minnesota's 23-16 victory over the Tampa Bay Buccaneers last Sunday.
An MRI confirmed a sprained left ankle for Jefferson, who did not participate in practice all week.
Jefferson played in all 17 regular-season games for Minnesota in 2024 and 2025. The seven-year veteran missed seven games in 2023 with a torn right hamstring.
With Jefferson sidelined, Jordan Addison and tight end T.J. Hockenson likely will see an increased workload for the Vikings (3-0) in their game against the Dolphins (0-3) in Minneapolis.
Jefferson, 27, has collected 13 receptions for 179 yards and two touchdowns in three games this season.
The 2022 Offensive Player of the Year, Jefferson has 592 catches for 8,659 yards and 44 touchdowns in 97 career games (94 starts) since being selected by the Vikings with the 22nd overall pick of the 2020 NFL Draft.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Autoridad ambiental de Colombia otorga licencia a proyecto Bucare, de Ecopetrol, permitiendo avance a etapa de producción
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales de Colombia (ANLA) informó el viernes que otorgó la licencia al Área de Desarrollo Bucare, operada por el conglomerado energético Ecopetrol en el sureste del país, con lo que el proyecto podrá avanzar hacia la etapa de producción.
items.body:
La Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales de Colombia (ANLA) informó el viernes que otorgó la licencia al Área de Desarrollo Bucare, operada por el conglomerado energético Ecopetrol en el sureste del país, con lo que el proyecto podrá avanzar hacia la etapa de producción.
La licencia contempla la construcción de infraestructura para la perforación de pozos, así como plataformas, instalaciones de producción, líneas de flujo, vías de acceso y sistemas asociados a la operación, en el municipio de Acacías, ubicado en el departamento del Meta, precisó la ANLA en un comunicado.
El proyecto abarcará un área de 10.412 hectáreas e incluirá infraestructura para la producción de hidrocarburos y para la generación de energía mediante un parque fotovoltaico de hasta 42 megavatios (MW).
"Durante la ejecución del proyecto, la ANLA mantendrá el seguimiento a las obligaciones establecidas en la licencia ambiental, verificando la implementación efectiva de las medidas de manejo, prevención, mitigación y compensación aprobadas", indicó la ANLA.
El plan prevé la construcción y operación de hasta 16 locaciones de producción, una Central de Facilidades de Producción (CPF) de hasta 42 hectáreas y tres facilidades satélites de hasta cinco hectáreas cada una.
Además, comprende hasta 33 kilómetros de nuevas vías de acceso, 132 kilómetros de líneas de flujo y 28 kilómetros de líneas de transmisión eléctrica de 34,5 y 115 kilovoltios (kV).
El Área de Desarrollo Bucare pertenece al bloque CPO-9, operado actualmente por Ecopetrol que alcanzó una producción promedio de 26.300 barriles por día al cierre del segundo trimestre de 2026.

items.title: Diesel tem leve alta na semana no Brasil e renova máxima desde abril, mostra ANP
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O preço médio do diesel S-10 nos postos do Brasil encerrou a semana com leve alta de 0,3%, a R$7,35 por litro, renovando máxima desde abril, apontou pesquisa da Agência Nacional do Petróleo, Gás Natural e Biocombustíveis (ANP) nesta sexta-feira.
items.body:
O preço médio do diesel S-10 nos postos do Brasil encerrou a semana com leve alta de 0,3%, a R$7,35 por litro, renovando máxima desde abril, apontou pesquisa da Agência Nacional do Petróleo, Gás Natural e Biocombustíveis (ANP) nesta sexta-feira.
A média atual, a maior desde os R$7,38 por litro entre 19 e 25 de abril, ocorre após nova escalada dos preços do petróleo no mercado internacional em setembro, quando o Brent voltou a superar US$100 o barril diante de tensões geopolíticas e ataques no Oriente Médio relacionados ao Irã.
O combustível mais consumido do Brasil acumulou um avanço de 6,8% desde o fim de agosto, com impacto da alta das cotações do mercado global para o Brasil.
Contudo, uma defasagem recorde registrada entre o preço da Petrobras e as cotações internacionais levantou preocupações sobre o adiamento de compras externas por importadores privados. Cerca de 30% do consumo nacional é atendido por importações.
Na semana passada, entretanto, o secretário de Petróleo, Gás Natural e Biocombustíveis do Ministério de Minas e Energia, Renato Dutra, afirmou que o abastecimento de diesel S-10 para outubro estava garantido no Brasil.
A pesquisa da ANP também indicou que o etanol hidratado teve leve alta de 0,7% nesta semana ante a semana anterior, a R$4,13 por litro, enquanto a gasolina ficou estável em R$6,55 por litro.

items.title: Entrega de materiais de campanha por carteiros não é irregular
items.author: Reuters Fact Check
items.creator: Reuters Fact Check
items.summary: Posts nas redes sociais sugerem ser irregular que carteiros distribuam materiais de campanha eleitoral, mas a entrega é legal e permitida por meio do serviço de mala direta.
items.body:
Posts nas redes sociais sugerem ser irregular que carteiros distribuam materiais de campanha eleitoral, mas a entrega é legal e permitida por meio do serviço de mala direta.
O conteúdo reproduz um vídeo registrado em Santa Catarina, no qual um homem pergunta a uma carteira se ela está entregando panfletos do PT, enquanto ela mostra uma pilha de flyers dos candidatos ao Senado Décio Lima e à Câmara dos Deputados Ana Paula Lima, ambos do PT catarinense.
"Todo mundo dos Correios é obrigado a entregar. Obrigatório", ela responde. "Com o nosso dinheiro", acrescenta o autor da filmagem.
"Correio entregando propaganda eleitoral do PT: pode?", diz a legenda das publicações , que circulam no Facebook e no Instagram.
A Reuters encontrou o vídeo publicado nesta quarta-feira no Instagram por um repórter de Santa Catarina, que disse ter recebido a filmagem de um seguidor "indignado". "A dúvida era: isso é permitido? Fui pesquisar e a resposta é sim", escreveu.
Não há na postagem informações sobre a cidade ou a data do episódio. A Reuters não conseguiu contato com o repórter até a publicação deste texto. Na tarde desta sexta-feira, o post estava indisponível.
Nas imagens, é possível identificar que os panfletos têm a etiqueta de Mala Direta dos Correios . Trata-se de um serviço para envio em massa de materiais impressos com fins promocionais, informativos ou eleitorais.
Os Correios enviaram uma nota à Reuters informando que o "serviço de Mala Direta pode ser contratado por quaisquer candidatos e partidos políticos".
"Os Correios esclarecem que a entrega de material de campanha eleitoral por seus carteiros ocorre de forma regular e em conformidade com a legislação brasileira", disseram.
Em postagem no Instagram , os Correios afirmaram ainda que "o carteiro atua no cumprimento de suas obrigações profissionais, o que não pode ser caracterizado como apoio político ou uso irregular da estatal".
A lei de 1978 que regulamentou os serviços postais no país incluiu a "exploração de publicidade comercial em objetos correspondência" entre as atividades dos Correios.
Já o Código Eleitoral assegura aos partidos políticos "a prioridade postal durante os 60 dias anteriores à realização das eleições, para remessa de material de propaganda de seus candidatos registrados" e multa para o funcionário em caso de descumprimento -- o benefício foi posteriormente estendido às federações partidárias e coligações.
Uma resolução do Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE) que definiu o calendário eleitoral deste ano estabeleceu a prioridade a partir de 5 de agosto de 2026 -- o primeiro turno está marcado para 4 de outubro.
O TSE também publicou uma resolução em 2019 dizendo ser crime "não assegurar à funcionária ou ao funcionário postal a prioridade prevista" no Código Eleitoral.
Além disso, a Lei das Eleições e outra resolução de 2019 consideram correspondência e despesas postais como gastos eleitorais que devem respeitar os registros e limites previstos na legislação.
Nas despesas eleitorais de Décio Lima declaradas ao TSE, há o valor de R$88.074 pagos aos Correios por correspondências e despesas postais . Não há gastos semelhantes até o momento na declaração de Ana Paula Lima .
VEREDICTO Sem contexto. A entrega de materiais de campanha eleitoral por funcionários dos Correios é permitida por lei.
Este artigo foi produzido pela equipe da Reuters Fact Check. Envie sugestões de checagem via WhatsApp pelo número (11) 91599-9278 . Leia mais sobre nosso trabalho de checagens de afirmações nas redes sociais aqui .

items.title: David Ellison says combined Paramount and Warner Bros Discovery will be named Skydance
items.author: Reuters Staff
items.summary: Paramount Skydance CEO David Ellison on Friday said upon closing the company’s merger with Warner Bros Discovery, the combined entity will be called Skydance.
items.body: Paramount Skydance CEO David Ellison on Friday said upon closing the company’s merger with Warner Bros Discovery, the combined entity will be called Skydance. The move was aimed at maintaining separate identities of the Paramount and Warner Bros studios, rather than have a new corporate identity overshadow them, Ellison added. The combined company will be an entertainment behemoth spanning film, TV and news, uniting the studios behind the “Mission: Impossible” and “Harry Potter” films with major television and streaming networks such as CBS, CNN, Paramount+ and HBO Max. “We never wanted a new corporate identity to diminish, alter or overshadow either one,” Ellison wrote in a social media post. “Instead, we wanted a name that would give the combined company an identity of its own while allowing Paramount and Warner Bros — and all our extraordinary brands — to remain in the spotlight.” The company plans to change its legal name to Skydance Corporation on October 6, according to a regulatory filing. On the same day, its Class B shares are expected to move from Nasdaq to the New York Stock Exchange, where they will trade under the ticker “SKYD” instead of “PSKY.” “The name is ego-driven. It reminds everyone that the most iconic Hollywood brands answer to Ellison and it is his company who won out,” said Ross Benes, senior analyst at Emarketer. A U.S. judge on Wednesday entered an order allowing Paramount Skydance to close its US$110 billion acquisition of Warner Bros Discovery, ending a months-long holdup. The order approved a September 21 settlement with a California-led group of 12 states that had sued to block the merger, arguing it would create a media giant capable of driving up film and TV prices. Ellison earlier this week named Ynon Kreiz as his co-CEO, tasking the Mattel CEO with running day-to-day operations and leading the integration, freeing him up to helm creative direction and overall strategy. The duo faces a target of saving US$6 billion in costs while managing roughly US$80 billion in combined debt. --- Reporting by Anzar Mehraj, Deborah Sophia and Jaspreet Singh in Bengaluru; Editing by Shreya Biswas; Editing by Joyjeet Das

items.title: What do we know about flydubai flight 1073?
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Here is what we know, and don't know, about the reported attempt by the copilot of flydubai flight 1073 to crash the plane on September 30 before it landed safely in Saudi Arabia.
items.body:
Here is what we know, and don't know, about the reported attempt by the copilot of flydubai flight 1073 to crash the plane on September 30 before it landed safely in Saudi Arabia.
WHAT HAPPENED TO THE PLANE? The flight, carrying more than 170 mostly Israeli passengers and crew, departed Dubai at 0305 GMT, according to flight data reviewed by Reuters.
At 0521 GMT in Saudi airspace it made a sudden, sharp turn and plunged towards the ground twice, before stabilising. The plane fell more than 16,000 feet in just over 30 seconds during its most dramatic dive.
It then put out distress signals indicating an emergency and unlawful interference. It changed course over Jordanian airspace and diverted to land in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia.
At one point the transponder was turned off for nearly half an hour, according to an Israeli official.
WHAT HAPPENED IN THE COCKPIT? The copilot attacked and wounded the captain during the flight, the captain, Israeli and Saudi officials say.
During one of the plane's plunges, [USN:L1N45O05O TEXT:"the wounded captain"] who was lying on the floor managed to open the door, he said, allowing passengers to enter the cockpit and overpower the copilot.
Israeli officials cite witnesses saying that the copilot was "bashing" the control panel, without elaborating. They say the copilot appeared to be trying to crash the plane.
[USN:L8N45N0K6 TEXT:"One of the passengers"] managed to steady the plane after the copilot was subdued, which he knew how to do after watching an air-crash TV show, according to his own account.
A second pair of off-duty pilots on board then took the controls and landed, according to witnesses and Israeli officials.
Both the copilot and the captain suffered injuries, Saudi officials said. Videos from inside the cabin verified by Reuters show a wounded captain and copilot and blood apparently smeared on walls, and the copilot restrained by the passengers.
WHAT ISN'T CLEAR? We don't know the exact timings of events on board, how the copilot overpowered the captain or what weapon he used. One passenger is heard in a video asking about a knife, and another talking about a stabbing.
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has raised the possibility that a crash axe kept on board was used.
HOW CLOSE DID THE PLANE COME TO CRASHING? At its steepest point, the plane was losing altitude at about 544 feet (166 metres) per second. Similar trajectories have resulted in several major crashes.
WHAT ROLE DID PASSENGERS PLAY? One woman noticed a commotion in the cockpit when the captain opened the door and alerted the rest of the plane. At least four [USN:L6N45M12C TEXT:"passengers rushed towards the cockpit"], attacking and restraining the copilot.
The passenger who then steadied the plane before the off-duty pilots could take over said he first pulled the copilot away from the controls with the help of the other passengers.
Two other passengers attacked the copilot and tied him up using earphone cables, one of them said. A doctor on board treated the wounded captain.
WHY WERE THERE OTHER TRAINED PILOTS ON THE FLIGHT? The two off-duty flydubai pilots were likely on board as backup for tired crew, a pilot interviewed by Reuters said. Middle East flights are often having to reroute because of the ongoing US-Israeli war with Iran, the pilot said.
[USN:L4N45N0NH TEXT:"Flydubai"] said on Friday a full investigation was underway.
WHAT DO WE KNOW ABOUT THE COPILOT? Israeli officials say the copilot is an Omani national and that he was trying to crash the plane.
Little else is known about his motives or identity. Omani authorities have not commented and there has been no comment from him or a representative.
After being treated for his injuries he was taken to Abu Dhabi, according to the Saudi interior ministry.
Netanyahu [USN:L1N45N0GR TEXT:"told Fox News"] that the copilot had undergone "Islamist radical indoctrination", without providing details, and that he was suicidal. Israeli security officials have said he was likely acting alone, though investigation is ongoing.
Israel's ambassador to the United Arab Emirates has said no motive has been determined.
WAS IRAN OR ANOTHER COUNTRY INVOLVED? Israeli security officials say Israel had not identified any Iranian involvement so far. Iran has not commented.
WHO IS HANDLING THE INVESTIGATION? The United Arab Emirates has [USN:S8N43T02X TEXT:"ordered"] an investigation. UAE judicial authorities have jurisdiction because the aircraft is registered in the UAE and flies under its flag.
Netanyahu said Israel, which has a close diplomatic and security relationship with the UAE, will be "possibly participating" in the investigation.
Saudi Arabia said it had conducted the preliminary investigation with security teams from the UAE.
HOW WAS THIS ALLOWED TO HAPPEN? Pilots undergo background checks and regular psychological assessments, part of stringent measures in place since the 9/11 attacks in the United States in 2001.
Israel has strict screening for anyone travelling there. That includes not normally allowing in pilots from countries without diplomatic relationships with Israel, such as Oman. Netanyahu has said Israel will look at the "loophole" that allowed the copilot on board.
Israel is set to [USN:S8N45108C TEXT:"ramp up"] security checks on pilots flying into the country, Netanyahu's office said.

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
＜ロンドン株式市場＞ 

反発して取引を終えた。今週は長期金利の上昇が相場の重しとなり、ＦＴＳＥ１００種は週間ベースで２．１８％安だった。中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は前日比０．２１％高、週間では０．２８％下落した。

米雇用統計が市場予想を下回る内容で、米利上げ観測がいくぶん後退した。欧州で軽油や原油の追加放出を巡って協議されていると伝わり、エネルギー供給ひっ迫への警戒感も和らいだ。

前日に２００７年以来の高水準を付けた英１０年債利回りは上昇が一服。ＦＴＳＥ３５０種住宅建設株指数は０．０７％高と反発した。銀行株指数は０．６１％高となったものの、週間では４．６３％下落。

オンライン金融取引のＩＧグループは前日比２２．６％安。市場環境の悪化を要因として売上高見通しを引き下げたことが売り材料視された。同業のプラス５００は５．２％、ＣＭＣマーケッツは４．０％、それぞれ下落した。

＜ロンドン株式市場＞ 

反発して取引を終えた。今週は長期金利の上昇が相場の重しとなり、ＦＴＳＥ１００種は週間ベースで２．１８％安だった。中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は前日比０．２１％高、週間では０．２８％下落した。

米雇用統計が市場予想を下回る内容で、米利上げ観測がいくぶん後退した。欧州で軽油や原油の追加放出を巡って協議されていると伝わり、エネルギー供給ひっ迫への警戒感も和らいだ。

前日に２００７年以来の高水準を付けた英１０年債利回りは上昇が一服。ＦＴＳＥ３５０種住宅建設株指数は０．０７％高と反発した。銀行株指数は０．６１％高となったものの、週間では４．６３％下落。

オンライン金融取引のＩＧグループは前日比２２．６％安。市場環境の悪化を要因として売上高見通しを引き下げたことが売り材料視された。同業のプラス５００は５．２％、ＣＭＣマーケッツは４．０％、それぞれ下落した。

好調な業績見通しを示した資源大手グレンコアは３．０％高。パブ経営のＪＤウェザースプーンは１２．５％上昇した。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞ 

反発して取引を終えた。原油高や長期金利上昇が一服したことで投資家心理が改善し、買い注文が優勢だった。米雇用統計が市場予想を下回る内容で、米利上げ観測がいくぶん後退した。ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種指数は週間ベースでは１．１４％安と反落した。

テクノロジー株指数は前日比２．６４％高。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連投資への期待感から半導体関連銘柄を物色する動きが目立った。ドイツのインフィニオン・テクノロジーズは８．８％、アイクストロンは７．６％、フランスのソイテックは７．７％、いずれも上昇した。

銀行株指数は０．１４％高。週間では４．８６％安だった。売上高見通しを引き下げたオンライン金融取引のＩＧグループは前日比２２．６％安。自社株買い計画を発表したスイスのプライベートバンク大手ジュリアス・ベアは２．０％高。

９月のユーロ圏消費者物価指数（ＨＩＣＰ）速報値は前年同月比の伸び率が拡大し、市場予想を上回った。今後数カ月でさらに上昇すると見られている。ＬＳＥＧによると、市場では１２月に欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が追加利上げするとの見方が８割超まで強まっている。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞　

フランス１０年債利回りが約２５年ぶりに５％近辺まで上昇する場面があった。終盤は９ｂｐ低下の４．８４４％。今週は１２ｂｐ上昇した。

今週は、財政問題の悪化とインフレ高進を巡る懸念からフランスの利回りが急上昇する一方、投資家がドイツ国債やオランダ国債などの安全資産に殺到するなど、波乱の１週間だった。２日の取引もボラティリティーの高い状況が続き、特にインフレや金利の予想に敏感な短期債で値動きが荒かった。

指標となる１０年物独連邦債の利回りは一時１３．７ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下した。終盤は６ｂｐ低下の３．４５６％で、週間では１７ｂｐの低下となる見通し。

これにより、仏独の利回り格差は約１４０ｂｐとなった。一時１６０ｂｐ近くに急拡大し、２０１１年末以来の高水準となった。

独２年債利回りは終盤に横ばいの３．０５％。日中は２．９４３％から３．０６３％のレンジで推移した。

一方、仏２年債利回りは約４ｂｐ上昇の３．７３％で、一時は３．８４％まで上昇した。伊２年債利回りは７ｂｐ低下の３．５４７％。

今週は、独２年債利回りが０．２５％ポイント近く低下した一方、仏２年債利回りは１４ｂｐ近く上昇した。

ＤＺバンクのアナリスト、レネ・アルブレヒト氏は「質への逃避」を指摘し、「安全資産への需要が高まっている」と述べた。

伊１０年債利回りは１１ｂｐ低下の４．６０９％となったが、週間では６ｂｐ上昇した。

items.body:
欧州市場サマリー（2日）
3:51 配信

＜ロンドン株式市場＞ 

反発して取引を終えた。今週は長期金利の上昇が相場の重しとなり、ＦＴＳＥ１００種は週間ベースで２．１８％安だった。中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は前日比０．２１％高、週間では０．２８％下落した。

米雇用統計が市場予想を下回る内容で、米利上げ観測がいくぶん後退した。欧州で軽油や原油の追加放出を巡って協議されていると伝わり、エネルギー供給ひっ迫への警戒感も和らいだ。

前日に２００７年以来の高水準を付けた英１０年債利回りは上昇が一服。ＦＴＳＥ３５０種住宅建設株指数は０．０７％高と反発した。銀行株指数は０．６１％高となったものの、週間では４．６３％下落。

オンライン金融取引のＩＧグループは前日比２２．６％安。市場環境の悪化を要因として売上高見通しを引き下げたことが売り材料視された。同業のプラス５００は５．２％、ＣＭＣマーケッツは４．０％、それぞれ下落した。

好調な業績見通しを示した資源大手グレンコアは３．０％高。パブ経営のＪＤウェザースプーンは１２．５％上昇した。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞ 

反発して取引を終えた。原油高や長期金利上昇が一服したことで投資家心理が改善し、買い注文が優勢だった。米雇用統計が市場予想を下回る内容で、米利上げ観測がいくぶん後退した。ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種指数は週間ベースでは１．１４％安と反落した。

テクノロジー株指数は前日比２．６４％高。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連投資への期待感から半導体関連銘柄を物色する動きが目立った。ドイツのインフィニオン・テクノロジーズは８．８％、アイクストロンは７．６％、フランスのソイテックは７．７％、いずれも上昇した。

銀行株指数は０．１４％高。週間では４．８６％安だった。売上高見通しを引き下げたオンライン金融取引のＩＧグループは前日比２２．６％安。自社株買い計画を発表したスイスのプライベートバンク大手ジュリアス・ベアは２．０％高。

９月のユーロ圏消費者物価指数（ＨＩＣＰ）速報値は前年同月比の伸び率が拡大し、市場予想を上回った。今後数カ月でさらに上昇すると見られている。ＬＳＥＧによると、市場では１２月に欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が追加利上げするとの見方が８割超まで強まっている。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞　

フランス１０年債利回りが約２５年ぶりに５％近辺まで上昇する場面があった。終盤は９ｂｐ低下の４．８４４％。今週は１２ｂｐ上昇した。

今週は、財政問題の悪化とインフレ高進を巡る懸念からフランスの利回りが急上昇する一方、投資家がドイツ国債やオランダ国債などの安全資産に殺到するなど、波乱の１週間だった。２日の取引もボラティリティーの高い状況が続き、特にインフレや金利の予想に敏感な短期債で値動きが荒かった。

指標となる１０年物独連邦債の利回りは一時１３．７ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下した。終盤は６ｂｐ低下の３．４５６％で、週間では１７ｂｐの低下となる見通し。

これにより、仏独の利回り格差は約１４０ｂｐとなった。一時１６０ｂｐ近くに急拡大し、２０１１年末以来の高水準となった。

独２年債利回りは終盤に横ばいの３．０５％。日中は２．９４３％から３．０６３％のレンジで推移した。

一方、仏２年債利回りは約４ｂｐ上昇の３．７３％で、一時は３．８４％まで上昇した。伊２年債利回りは７ｂｐ低下の３．５４７％。

今週は、独２年債利回りが０．２５％ポイント近く低下した一方、仏２年債利回りは１４ｂｐ近く上昇した。

ＤＺバンクのアナリスト、レネ・アルブレヒト氏は「質への逃避」を指摘し、「安全資産への需要が高まっている」と述べた。

伊１０年債利回りは１１ｂｐ低下の４．６０９％となったが、週間では６ｂｐ上昇した。

items.title: US FAA says Boeing 737 MAX software glitch poses no safety issue
items.author: David Shepardson
items.creator: David Shepardson
items.summary: The Federal Aviation Administration said on Friday that a panel of experts had determined a software glitch in some Boeing 737 MAX flight computers poses no safety concern, clearing the way for approval of a larger version of the best-selling narrow-body jet.
items.body:
The Federal Aviation Administration said on Friday that a panel of experts had determined a software glitch in some Boeing 737 MAX flight computers poses no safety concern, clearing the way for approval of a larger version of the best-selling narrow-body jet.
The decision removes a late obstacle to certification of the MAX 10, the largest variant of the 737 MAX family, which has been delayed for years. It should also ease concerns at airlines that fly the MAX 7, which uses the same software and was certified by the FAA in August.
The FAA said the determination by the Corrective Action Review Board that met in Seattle on Friday was based on the fact that "pilots retain full control of the aircraft and the indications to the flight crew are clear and unambiguous."
The FAA said earlier this week it was delaying certification of the MAX 10 until it completed an analysis of the software issue, which could prevent pilots from accessing automated flight guidance during an unusual landing scenario.
Boeing said it "will continue to follow the lead of the FAA as our engineers work on the next software update." Boeing added it is working directly with airlines to formalize a procedure that will allow pilots "to re-enable automated vertical navigation should this situation occur."
Aviation officials now believe the MAX 10 could be certified as soon as later this month. The issue could also have affected Southwest Airlines (LUV.N) because the same software is used on the newly certified MAX 7 airplane. Other large airlines, including Alaska Airlines (ALK.N) and United Airlines (UAL.O) , that have ordered the MAX 10 could also have been impacted by a lengthy delay.
Jefferies said in a research note the decision allows the MAX 10 to be certified before the end of the year and estimated Boeing has nearly 1,500 MAX 10s on order from airlines.
The FAA said one software version can increase pilot workload during a go-around, when a pilot aborts a landing attempt, applies power, and climbs to make another landing attempt.
An FAA official said Boeing will issue a bulletin to airlines on how to recognize and respond to the situation should it occur, and the FAA will issue a Special Airworthiness Information Bulletin to US airlines and foreign regulators to ensure they’re aware of Boeing’s bulletin.
Major US airlines had opted not to use that version of the software while the analysis was underway.

items.title: Colombia reports expansion of mostly illegal alluvial gold mining
items.author: Luis Jaime Acosta
items.creator: Luis Jaime Acosta
items.summary: Mostly illegal alluvial gold production in Colombia expanded 4.5% by area year-on-year in 2025 to 118,410 hectares, with the increase primarily on Afro-Colombian communities' land, a report by the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC) and the government showed on Friday.
items.body:
Mostly illegal alluvial gold production in Colombia expanded 4.5% by area year-on-year in 2025 to 118,410 hectares, with the increase primarily on Afro-Colombian communities' land, a report by the United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC) and the government showed on Friday.
The increase of 5,100 hectares compared to 2024 marked the third consecutive year of growth, the UNODC told Reuters.
"Seventy-five percent (of alluvial gold production) is illegal, 21% has technical and/or environmental permits, and 4% is in the process of becoming legal," the report said.
Alluvial gold is found in river and stream beds and is typically extracted with gravity-based separation methods such as panning, sluicing and mechanized dredging and washing.
Because the techniques require relatively little equipment and investment, alluvial deposits often attract small-scale illegal or informal miners.
Nearly half of Colombia's 32 departments showed evidence of alluvial gold exploitation last year, with 61% of the increase on Afro-Colombian lands. Alluvial gold production was also detected in 30 Indigenous reserves, the report said.
Indigenous and Black Colombians have historically been more likely to be victims of the country's six-decade-long conflict, suffer poverty and live in more isolated areas.
Almost half of the areas where the production took place are zones where mining is not permitted, including forest reserves and national parks.
According to security sources, illegal gold mining is the second-largest source of financing for illegal armed groups after drug trafficking.
Illegal gold mining is destroying forests and polluting rivers with chemicals, Mines and Energy Minister Maria Nohemi Arboleda said during the presentation of the report.
Seventy-nine municipalities with alluvial gold mining in 2025 also had coca cultivation.
"Nearly half of the area with alluvial gold mining also has coca crops. It's a mix, a perfect business. This is not a debate about mining. It is a confrontation between the state and criminal economies that use gold to finance violence," Arboleda said.
Arboleda said countries that buy gold should require traceability systems to verify the metal is legally sourced.

items.title: Djokovic says season has been 'a big, big struggle' after latest medical timeout
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Novak Djokovic said this year has been a massive struggle, but insisted it was not due to stamina issues and was instead linked to an undisclosed health problem, after requiring another medical timeout at the China Open on Friday.
items.body:
Novak Djokovic said this year has been a massive struggle, but insisted it was not due to stamina issues and was instead linked to an undisclosed health problem, after requiring another medical timeout at the China Open on Friday.
The 24-time Grand Slam champion battled back from a set down to beat local hope and world number 104 Bu Yunchaokete 4-6 7-6(2) 6-2 in the last 16 in Beijing, extending his perfect record at the tournament to 31-0.
Djokovic, who returned to the ATP 500 event after an 11-year absence as he seeks to regain momentum following his exit from the top 10, is aiming for a strong finish to a season that included a shock first-round loss at the U.S. Open, his earliest Grand Slam defeat since the 2006 Australian Open.
The 39-year-old Serb vomited midway through the U.S. Open match and was troubled by back and shoulder issues that affected his serve late on. He had also required a medical timeout during his opening-round victory over Portugal's Nuno Borges in Beijing.
"I don't want to go into details because then it's going to sound like I'm whining about something or looking for excuses," Djokovic told a news conference.
"Truth is that this year has been a big, big struggle for me with few particular issues that I've been having. I've been just trying to find different ways to be at least giving myself a decent condition physically and health-wise to be on the court and compete with the player across the net.
"Most of the matches and tournaments this year that I've played have been a real, real struggle for me physically. That's nothing to do with stamina. People mix it up. It's not stamina. It's something else. More related to health."
Djokovic did not elaborate on the problem but said he and his team were still trying to get to the root of it.
"Actually surprisingly something I haven't experienced this year so far, that in the third set I kind of broke through. I felt better. Towards the end of the second and all third set, I felt fresher than I have in the beginning of the match...," he added.
"It's not fun when you're feeling like that on the court because then I'm investing my emotional, mental energy, and physical of course, more on the issues that I'm having rather than thinking about the game and how I can beat my opponent."
Djokovic has won a record six China Open titles, most recently in 2015 before making his return to the tournament this season.

items.title: Owners of Brazil's Braskem finalizing counter proposal to $3 billion capital demand
items.author: Luciana Magalhaes, Rodrigo Viga Gaier
items.creator: Luciana Magalhaes, Rodrigo Viga Gaier
items.summary: Controlling shareholders of Brazil's Braskem are finalizing a counter proposal for the company's creditors after balking at lenders' demands to inject $3 billion into the petrochemical producer, two people familiar with the matter told Reuters on Friday.
items.body:
Controlling shareholders of Brazil's Braskem (BRKM3.SA) are finalizing a counter proposal for the company's creditors after balking at lenders' demands to inject $3 billion into the petrochemical producer, two people familiar with the matter told Reuters on Friday.
"It would be too large an injection of funds, it is far more than the company's current valuation," one source said, adding that fully meeting the request in the short time would be impossible. Negotiations continue and that a counteroffer will likely be submitted within days, the source said.
Braskem's restructuring should rely more on operational improvements than on fresh equity, a second person said, adding that while new funding has not been ruled out entirely, any decision would depend on broader negotiations and potential adjustments.
In September, creditors demanded a $3 billion capital injection from Braskem's controlling shareholders, state-run oil firm Petrobras (PETR3.SA) and private equity firm IG4 Capital, after the company issued a $10.9 billion out-of-court restructuring filing on August 24.
Braskem has until late November to come up with a final plan with support of more than half of its creditors to avoid filing for bankruptcy.
IG4 declined to comment. Petrobras and Braskem declined to comment.
Earlier this month, Petrobras Chief Executive Officer Magda Chambriard told journalists in Rio de Janeiro that the company is unwilling to increase its stake in Braskem, signaling it will not inject further capital unless matched by other investors.
Braskem is currently worth some 3.25 billion reais ($621.8 million), after the value of its shares fell by half in 2026.
Creditors consider fresh cash essential and expect shareholders to bear their share of the burden, a third source said, signaling tense negotiations ahead.
Braskem and its creditors are already at odds over fund transfers to the company's Mexican unit, Braskem Idesa, as part of a $415 million financing package and a $71 million capital injection linked to the unit's Chapter 11 filing, which also started in August.
In late September, a Brazilian court blocked Braskem from transferring more funds to the unit, which is a joint venture with Mexico's Grupo Idesa [RIC:RIC:GSDC.UL].
Braskem appealed the ruling, but the matter is still pending. If overturned, resuming transfers would allow Braskem Idesa to exit Chapter 11 by November or before, a fourth source told Reuters.

items.title: Fed officials give hints on rate decision as markets cut October rate hike odds
items.author: ETMarkets.com
items.summary: Fed officials tempered expectations for an October rate hike after Philip Jefferson and John Williams stressed patience and data dependence. Markets sharply reduced hike odds, though persistent inflation and upcoming consumer price data could shape the Federal Reserve’s policy decision.
items.body: Federal Reserve officials have gone quite a long way to offer strong signals into possible direction of interest rates despite chairman Kevin Warsh's strong reluctance to give any guidance whatsoever, and that has helped traders reassess their positions on the rate decision, according to a Bloomberg report.Fed Vice Chair Philip Jefferson and New York Fed President John Williams have in recent days suggested that policymakers believe the central bank has time to assess the economy before considering another increase.The remarks do not mean the Fed has ruled out further policy tightening, Bloomberg reported. Officials continue to warn that inflation remains too high, while consumer price data due on October 14 could play a major role in determining the next policy move.Ellen Meade, an economics professor at Duke University who advised Fed officials during a decades-long career at the Board of Governors, told Bloomberg the speeches by Jefferson and Williams did not necessarily amount to traditional forward guidance.“This is the Fed behaving like the Fed,” said Meade. “But I think there’s a difference between forward guidance that locks in a rate change and forward guidance that says we’re going to take our time making a decision and collect a lot of data. Subtle, but there’s a difference,” she said.William English, a professor at the Yale School of Management and a former Fed division director, said he did not believe the Jefferson and Williams speeches were coordinated, according to Bloomberg.“These were people who were giving speeches that they thought were the right speeches, giving their views about the economy and policy,” he said.Meanwhile, three regional Fed presidents appearing together at a conference in Asheville, North Carolina, declined to provide clues about their expectations for the central bank’s final two meetings of the year. Richmond Fed President Tom Barkin, Boston Fed President Susan Collins and Kansas City Fed President Jeff Schmid instead pointed to upcoming economic data.“Let’s see how things develop,” Barkin said.Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee on Friday said there is room for both a rate hike and a rate cut on the table. He said the latest jobs data show the labor market is steady and that too-high inflation remains the Fed's bigger policy priority, but added that he would look at more evidence that suggests we're headed back to 2% inflation .The Jefferson and Williams remarks were followed by comments from Michelle Bowman, a Fed governor and the central bank’s top banking regulator, who said there was little urgency to move rates again.Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan, one of the Fed’s strongest advocates for rate hikes this year, said multiple additional increases would probably be needed to bring inflation fully back to the central bank’s 2% target. However, she also pointed to rising term premiums in bond markets, or the additional yield investors demand to hold longer-dated debt. Higher term premiums could also help slow the economy, she said.The comments triggered a sharp repricing of expectations for Fed interest rates over the remainder of the year.Eric Wallerstein, chief macro strategist for Clocktower Group and previously an adviser to former Fed Governor Stephen Miran, told Bloomberg the remarks from Jefferson and Williams represented clear attempts to correct market expectations.“Officials are doing what they’ve always done,” Wallerstein said. “Talking to the market when pricing reflects the ‘wrong’ reality.”Close observers of the Fed said the broader takeaway from the speeches was that traders had moved too far in betting on another hike following the Fed’s Sept. 16 increase, particularly as a sharp rise in bond yields pushed borrowing costs higher.Before Williams spoke on Tuesday, traders saw a 70% probability of a hike at the Oct. 27-28 meeting, based on federal funds futures pricing. By the time Jefferson finished his speech on Thursday, those odds had fallen to about 25%, with softer-than-expected inflation data also contributing to the shift.As president of the New York Fed, Williams has a permanent vote on monetary policy and, by tradition, serves as vice chair of the Federal Open Market Committee. Alongside the chair and vice chair, the New York Fed president has historically been viewed as part of the central bank’s leadership “troika” on monetary policy.Under some previous Fed chairs, investors interpreted comments from the vice chair or New York Fed president as signals of the broader views of the troika. There is no evidence, however, that Jefferson and Williams coordinated their speeches with each other or with Warsh, Bloomberg reported.Goldman Sachs economists said the combination of the Jefferson and Williams speeches reinforced their view that an October rate hike is unlikely, a conclusion echoed by other analysts.“We think the joint message from Jefferson and Williams is authoritative,” Krishna Guha, head of economics at Evercore ISI, and colleagues wrote in a note to clients Thursday after Jefferson made his remarks.Michael Feroli, chief US economist at JPMorgan Chase & Co., told Bloomberg the two speeches represented a clear effort to manage market expectations.“In both cases, it’s the message that you don’t have to keep piling hike on hike, meeting per meeting, and that you can kind of space things out a little bit here,” he said.Fed policymakers last month unanimously voted to raise interest rates by a quarter percentage point, marking the first increase since 2023 as the broader economy accelerated and inflation remained stubbornly high. In projections released after the decision, officials indicated support for one additional rate hike this year.Warsh, however, has moved away from actively steering market expectations through forward guidance. He does not participate in the quarterly rate projections and has avoided signaling future policy moves in public remarks. Instead, he has encouraged investors to focus on incoming economic data.The shift has attracted support from some economists and market observers. Critics of forward guidance argue that it can be useful during a crisis but has less value when economic conditions are changing rapidly and policymakers have limited visibility into the outlook.(Disclaimer: This article is based on inputs from agencies. These do not represent the views of The Economic Times)

Markets sharply reduced hike odds, though persistent inflation and upcoming consumer price data could shape the Federal Reserve’s policy decision.

items.title: Mexico needs more effort to lower debt, IMF says
items.author: Diego Oré, Raul Cortes
items.creator: Diego Oré, Raul Cortes
items.summary: The International Monetary Fund said on Friday that greater efforts are needed to put Mexico's debt on a declining trajectory, even as fiscal consolidation continues in 2026, following an Article IV consultation mission to Mexico City in September.
items.body:
The International Monetary Fund said on Friday that greater efforts are needed to put Mexico's debt on a declining trajectory, even as fiscal consolidation continues in 2026, following an Article IV consultation mission to Mexico City in September.
The fund projected Mexico's economy will grow 1.5% in 2026 and 1.8% in 2027, though growth remains constrained mainly by external uncertainty, and called for monetary policy to maintain a moderately tight stance to lock in disinflation.
Revenue mobilization, better spending prioritization and greater private sector involvement are needed to protect growth-enhancing investment, the IMF said.
Headline inflation is near the central bank's target, though core price pressures and inflation expectations remain elevated, the IMF said.
The IMF warned that geopolitical tensions and the effects of El Niño could add pressure to prices and delay a durable return to Banxico's 3% inflation target until early 2028.
Banxico held its benchmark interest rate at 6.50% in September and expects inflation to return to its 3% target in the fourth quarter of 2027, though risks remain tilted to the upside.
FISCAL POLICY The IMF said Mexico's draft 2027 budget entails a more gradual fiscal consolidation than previously announced and an upward debt trajectory in coming years.
Mexico's financial system is sound, but improvements to anti-money laundering and counter-terrorism financing frameworks and deeper financial intermediation are needed, the fund added.
According to the IMF, raising potential growth in Mexico requires closing infrastructure gaps, reducing regulatory burdens and strengthening trade integration, according to the IMF.
Improving security, combating corruption and lowering informality were also cited as necessary to lift growth potential.
Mexico's 2027 budget projects public debt rising to 55.0% of GDP from an estimated 54.0% at the end of 2026, even as the government continues its fiscal consolidation efforts.
