items.title: A qué hora comienza la votación este domingo por las elecciones de Brasil 2026
items.author: Fátima Romero
items.summary: El domingo, más de 158 millones de brasileños acudirán a las urnas en todo el país para elegir al presidente de la República, a los gobernadores, a los senadores y a los diputados federales, así como ...
items.body: Bloomberg Línea — La votación de la primera vuelta de las elecciones generales de Brasil comienza este domingo 4 de octubre a las 8:00 y termina a las 17:00, según el horario de Brasilia, que rige de manera uniforme para todo el país. Ver más: Elecciones en Brasil 2026: qué proponen Lula y Flávio Bolsonaro en economía, seguridad y energía Más de 158 millones de electores están convocados a las urnas para elegir presidente, gobernadores, senadores y diputados. El horario oficial es uno solo, pero como Brasil tiene cuatro husos horarios, la hora en el reloj local cambia en algunas regiones. En Rondônia, Mato Grosso, Mato Grosso do Sul, Roraima y la mayor parte del estado de Amazonas, las mesas se habilitarán de 7:00 a 16:00, hora local. En Acre y en 11 municipios del oeste de Amazonas (Amaturá, Atalaia do Norte, Benjamin Constant, Eirunepé, Envira, Guajará, Ipixuna, Itamarati, Jutaí, Tabatinga y São Paulo de Olivença), la votación va de 6:00 a 15:00. En Fernando de Noronha, en cambio, se desarrolla de 9:00 a 18:00. Quienes votan en el exterior deben consultar el horario definido para cada local. Esta simultaneidad fue determinada por el Tribunal Superior Electoral (TSE) en diciembre de 2021, cuando unificó el horario de votación tomando a Brasilia como referencia. Será el tercer proceso con esta regla. Antes, la Justicia Electoral esperaba el cierre de las mesas de Acre, con dos horas menos que la capital, y recién entonces iniciaba el escrutinio, que comenzaba cerca de las 19:00. Con la unificación, los primeros resultados parciales podrán difundirse a partir de las 17:00 del domingo, apenas cierren las urnas, de manera simultánea en todo el país. El votante que se encuentre en la fila a la hora de cierre tendrá derecho a votar. En ese caso, el equipo de la mesa electoral repartirá tickets, empezando por la última persona de la cola, para controlar el acceso. En cambio, quien llegue después del cierre no podrá votar, aunque la sección siga abierta atendiendo a quienes ya estaban. Las autoridades electorales recomiendan consultar con antelación la ubicación y la mesa electoral en el e-Título o en el Autoservicio Electoral. Dado que la hora será la misma en todo Brasil, los residentes de estados con diferencia horaria deberán acudir antes según la hora local. En esta elección, los brasileños eligen cinco cargos: presidente de la República, gobernador, dos senadores, diputados federales y diputados estatales o distritales. Ver más: Multa electoral: de cuánto es en 2026 y cómo pagarla desde el aplicativo En la urna electrónica, el orden de votación es: diputado federal, diputado estatal o distrital, primer senador, segundo senador, gobernador y presidente. Si ningún candidato a presidente o gobernador alcanza la mayoría necesaria, habrá segunda vuelta el 25 de octubre, entre las 8 y las 17 y con el mismo criterio horario. Para votar, el elector debe presentar un documento oficial con foto —cédula de identidad, licencia de conducir, pasaporte, credencial profesional, libreta de trabajo o certificado de reservista, incluso vencidos— o la aplicación e-Título, siempre que en la pantalla aparezca su foto. No se admiten partidas de nacimiento ni de matrimonio. También está permitido llevar una “colilla electoral” con los números de los candidatos, ya que los celulares y las cámaras no pueden ingresar a la cabina de votación, con el objetivo de garantizar el secreto del sufragio. Quienes no puedan concurrir tienen opciones para justificar su ausencia. El mismo domingo, entre las 8:00 y las 17:00, pueden hacerlo por la aplicación e-Título, en los locales de votación o en las mesas especiales de justificación, sin necesidad de presentar documentos que acrediten el motivo. También es posible justificar hasta 60 días después de cada turno, aunque en ese caso sí se exige documentación que respalde la falta. La Justicia Electoral, además, establece atención prioritaria en las filas para personas con discapacidad o movilidad reducida, personas con trastorno del espectro autista, mayores de 80 años —que pasan al frente de todos—, mayores de 60, embarazadas, lactantes, personas con niños en brazos y personas enfermas. La prioridad se extiende al acompañante de quien tenga derecho a ella.

FILE PHOTO: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg wears the Meta Ray-Ban Display glasses, as he delivers a speech presenting the new line of smart glasses, during the Meta Connect event at the company's headquarters in Menlo Park, California, U.S., September 17, 2025. REUTERS/Carlos Barria/File Photo

AMSTERDAM, Oct 2 : One of the largest Dutch eyewear retail chains said on Friday it had suspended sales of Meta's Ray-Ban smart glasses in the Netherlands and Belgium amid growing privacy concerns, in one of the first such moves by a retailer.
"This decision follows the ongoing public and political debate surrounding smart glasses and the questions being raised about the conditions under which this technology can be used," a spokesperson for the Hans Anders chain said.
A growing Dutch outcry over the glasses mirrors a broader backlash against smart glasses equipped with cameras.
In Britain, pub chain Wetherspoon has restricted use of Meta's glasses over concerns about covert recording, while Meta and Luxottica face a US suit alleging videos captured by the glasses were viewed by human annotators without the knowledge of people filmed.

A Meta spokesperson said the company is continuing to develop the popular glasses. "Every pair with a camera has a bright light on the front that blinks when you take a photo or video — it can't be turned off, and the camera is disabled if someone covers or tampers with it," they said.  
In the Netherlands, privacy regulator AP last month warned that videos made with smart glasses showing identifiable people cannot generally be shared or published without their permission, which would be difficult to obtain in a public place. 
Consumer rights group Consumentenbond this week said it would take Meta to court unless the company changes the glasses to comply with privacy law.
Offlimits, a group that combats online abuse, on Friday also urged Meta and Ray-Ban owner EssilorLuxottica to voluntarily remove the glasses from sale until a way can be found to make surreptitious recordings impossible.
EssilorLuxottica could not immediately be reached for comment.
Hans Anders is a subsidiary of Nexeye, which is owned by private equity firm KKR. Nexeye operates 776 stores across the Netherlands, Belgium, Germany, Austria and Sweden. It does not sell the glasses in the latter three countries. 

Source: Reuters

GENEVA: Three-in-four families in parts of Yemen are going hungry from the "absolutely devastating" impact of a surge in fighting, which has displaced tens of thousands of people and disrupted supplies to millions, the World Food Programme said on Friday (Oct 2).
Yemen is experiencing the most serious escalation in fighting between Saudi Arabia and the Iran-aligned Houthi group since a UN-brokered truce largely halted cross-border attacks in 2022. The renewed conflict could reshape control in Yemen, with implications for Red Sea shipping lanes.
Within just a few weeks, the fighting has driven the share of households without sufficient food to 74% in government-controlled areas accessible to WFP, the UN hunger body's Assistant Executive Director for Programme Operations told reporters in Geneva. The total population of government-held areas is estimated at around 10 million people.
“The effect of this latest flare-up of insecurity on the food security situation threatens to be absolutely devastating,” Hollingworth told reporters in Geneva via video link from Rome.

The Houthis, who already control most of northern Yemen including the capital Sanaa, seized the country's entire Red Sea coast last month from Saudi-backed forces of the internationally recognised government, based in the southern port of Aden.
Displaced families are arriving outside Aden and around the mountain city of Taiz without any water or food, as many had to leave everything behind, WFP said.

Related:

Houthis say Saudi strikes on Yemen's Taiz leave dozens of casualties

Saudi coalition accuses Houthis of drone attack on Madinah

Prices of basic food staples such as wheat flour and vegetable oil are rising in a country that imports around 90 per cent of its food.
“We are looking at a hunger crisis that is going to grow as it persists,” Hollingworth said, adding that frontline areas like Taiz were increasingly hard to access due to the fighting.
WFP said it was scaling up its response but unless it gets around US$109 million in funding within a few weeks it will run out of food stocks and money to help the 152,000 newly displaced persons inside the country, as well as the 1.4 million people it is already supporting.
Hollingworth also pointed to the potential ripple effects of disruption to two major chokepoints in the Middle East: the Bab el-Mandeb Strait near Yemen at the mouth of the Red Sea and the Strait of Hormuz on the opposite side of the Arabian Peninsula.
That, as well as disruption in the Black Sea due to the Ukraine-Russia conflict, risk driving up food and fuel prices and deepening food insecurity globally.
A new analysis published by UN Women on Friday said an additional 11.7 million women and girls across 28 countries including Yemen, Sudan and Lebanon could face food insecurity by the end of the year, due to escalation in the Middle East and disruption to the Strait of Hormuz.

Source: Reuters/ec

GENEVA: Three-in-four families in parts of Yemen are going hungry from the "absolutely devastating" impact of a surge in fighting, which has displaced tens of thousands of people and disrupted supplies to millions, the World Food Programme said on Friday (Oct 2).
Yemen is experiencing the most serious escalation in fighting between Saudi Arabia and the Iran-aligned Houthi group since a UN-brokered truce largely halted cross-border attacks in 2022. The renewed conflict could reshape control in Yemen, with implications for Red Sea shipping lanes.
Within just a few weeks, the fighting has driven the share of households without sufficient food to 74% in government-controlled areas accessible to WFP, the UN hunger body's Assistant Executive Director for Programme Operations told reporters in Geneva. The total population of government-held areas is estimated at around 10 million people.
“The effect of this latest flare-up of insecurity on the food security situation threatens to be absolutely devastating,” Hollingworth told reporters in Geneva via video link from Rome.

The Houthis, who already control most of northern Yemen including the capital Sanaa, seized the country's entire Red Sea coast last month from Saudi-backed forces of the internationally recognised government, based in the southern port of Aden.
Displaced families are arriving outside Aden and around the mountain city of Taiz without any water or food, as many had to leave everything behind, WFP said.

Related:

Houthis say Saudi strikes on Yemen's Taiz leave dozens of casualties

Saudi coalition accuses Houthis of drone attack on Madinah

Prices of basic food staples such as wheat flour and vegetable oil are rising in a country that imports around 90 per cent of its food.
“We are looking at a hunger crisis that is going to grow as it persists,” Hollingworth said, adding that frontline areas like Taiz were increasingly hard to access due to the fighting.
WFP said it was scaling up its response but unless it gets around US$109 million in funding within a few weeks it will run out of food stocks and money to help the 152,000 newly displaced persons inside the country, as well as the 1.4 million people it is already supporting.
Hollingworth also pointed to the potential ripple effects of disruption to two major chokepoints in the Middle East: the Bab el-Mandeb Strait near Yemen at the mouth of the Red Sea and the Strait of Hormuz on the opposite side of the Arabian Peninsula.
That, as well as disruption in the Black Sea due to the Ukraine-Russia conflict, risk driving up food and fuel prices and deepening food insecurity globally.
A new analysis published by UN Women on Friday said an additional 11.7 million women and girls across 28 countries including Yemen, Sudan and Lebanon could face food insecurity by the end of the year, due to escalation in the Middle East and disruption to the Strait of Hormuz.

Source: Reuters/ec

items.title: Plaza financiera argentina opera con divergencias, salto del riesgo país
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El mercado financiero argentino arrojó el viernes una nueva ronda de marcada selectividad y prudencia, mientras que el riesgo país trepaba a los 655 puntos básicos como nivel preocupante y tope en 10 meses.
items.body:
El mercado financiero argentino arrojó el viernes una nueva ronda de marcada selectividad y prudencia, mientras que el riesgo país trepaba a los 655 puntos básicos como nivel preocupante y tope en 10 meses.
Las miradas de los inversores posaron también en el impacto del dato de empleo en Estados Unidos y las implicancias políticas regionales con las elecciones presidenciales del domingo en el vecino Brasil.
En la bolsa de Buenos Aires, el referencial accionario S&P Merval (.MERV) arrojó una mejora del 0,32% al cierre, al tiempo que los bonos soberanos extrabursátiles promediaron una caída del 0,5% a contramano de la positividad de Wall Street.
"El mercado en Estados Unidos reaccionó positivamente a datos peores que los esperados de tasa de desempleo y nóminas de empleados (...) La tasa de desempleo subió a 4,2%, frente al 4,1% esperado. Un mercado laboral más débil le quita fuerza a la expectativa de suba de tasas en la próxima reunión de la FED en octubre", remarcó Quantum Finanzas.
Mientras tanto, el riesgo país argentino subía a su máximo desde finales de noviembre pasado, muy lejos de las ansiadas 250 a 300 unidades como para que eventualmente el Gobierno pensara en retornar a los mercados internacionales de crédito ante un pesado panorama de vencimientos en el 2027.
"Para la Argentina, el resultado electoral de Brasil no es neutro en el plano político: un nuevo mandato de Lula (da Silva)prolongaría la distancia con la Casa Rosada, mientras que un triunfo de (Flavio) Bolsonaro abriría una etapa de mayor afinidad con el Gobierno de (Javier) Milei", reportó la consultora ABECEB.
"Sin embargo, el comercio bilateral se mantiene firme pese al enfriamiento diplomático, porque responde a una lógica productiva, con el intercambio automotriz como columna vertebral, que los vaivenes de la política no alcanzan a alterar", agregó.
El peso mayorista ganó un 0,23% a 1.521,5 por dólar , con regulación del banco central (BCRA) mediante la compra diaria de divisas para reforzar sus reservas internacionales.
Esta entidad sumó 35 millones de dólares este viernes y terminó la semana con un saldo favorable de 369 millones en su intervención.

items.title: 再送Ｇ７、石油備蓄1億バレル協調放出へ　当初は軽油重点で市場安定化狙う
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
(見出しの脱字を補います。)

[パリ ２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
(見出しの脱字を補います。)

[パリ ２日 ロイター] - 主要７カ国（Ｇ７）は２日の首脳共同声明で、世界のエネルギー市場の安定化に向け、国際エネルギー機関（ＩＥＡ）を通じてディーゼル燃料（軽油）などの石油備蓄１億バレルを協調放出すると発表した。直ちに開始し、４カ月間にわたって実施する。

Ｇ７議長国のフランス大統領府が公表した声明によると、Ｇ７加盟国とパートナー国は最初の２０日間に大量の軽油を重点的に放出する。マクロン仏大統領は、放出対象は軽油と原油で、規模は最大１億バレルになると説明した。

放出する原油、軽油、その他の製品の内訳は示されていないほか、どの国が参加するのか明記されていない。声明は「今後数日中にＩＥＡの枠組みにおいて会合を開き、必要に応じて軽油の追加放出の可能性について協議する」とした。

Ｇ７の発表に先立ち、トランプ米大統領は交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」への投稿で「欧州は大量に備蓄しているディーゼルを大規模に放出することに合意した。手続きは直ちに開始される」と表明していた。

Ｇ７はまた、加盟各国の製油所の保守点検日程を調整する方針を表明。ＩＥＡに対し、２０２６年３月のコミットメントが直ちにかつ完全に履行されるよう監視することを要請した。

エネルギーおよびエネルギー製品について、Ｇ７諸国間で輸出制限を控えるとの約束を再確認。全ての生産国に対し、市場の緊張を悪化させかねない禁止措置を導入しないよう求めた。

マクロン氏は、ホルムズ海峡を通じたエネルギー供給の確保に向け、引き続き行動を調整することで合意したと述べた。

声明はイランによる近隣諸国への攻撃を改めて非難し、ロシアに対する制裁を維持する方針も示した。

items.title: Chinese auto show debuts in Argentina as sales surge
items.author: Leila Miller
items.creator: Leila Miller
items.summary: Buenos Aires is hosting its first Chinese auto show on Friday as Argentina’s car market under President Javier Milei has shifted from heavy protectionism to a more open and competitive environment.
items.body:
Buenos Aires is hosting its first Chinese auto show on Friday as Argentina’s car market under President Javier Milei has shifted from heavy protectionism to a more open and competitive environment.
Chinese brands are flooding the market, benefiting from a measure that allows in up to 50,000 electric and hybrid vehicles without tariffs in 2026. Chinese brands accounted for 10% of car and light commercial vehicle sales in Argentina in August, up from about 2% late last year.
Since launching in Argentina [USN:L6N3VO0YF TEXT:"in late 2025"], China's electric vehicle maker BYD (002594.SZ) has become the ninth best-selling car brand. The company leads electric car sales in Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador and Uruguay.
At the auto show, more than 20 Chinese brands, including [USN:L4N45E0BT TEXT:"Geely"] (0175.HK) , Chery (9973.HK) , GWM (601633.SS) and [USN:L1N45K00B TEXT:"Dongfeng"], were on display. German Molina, a 3D designer who already owns a Chinese car and wants to buy another, looked around with his wife and son.
"If you go out onto the main avenues or neighborhoods, you see a large number of Chinese cars, and it’s not just one brand, but many different ones," said Molina. "I believe it’s only a matter of time before people start embracing them a bit more."
Sebastian Beato, president of Argentina’s auto dealers’ association ACARA, said the "impressive" growth among Chinese brands had pushed the national industry to produce new models, such as the [USN:L8N4500PL TEXT:"Renault Niagara"] pick-up truck unveiled in September.
Earlier this week the Argentine government said Japanese automaker Toyota Motor (7203.T) would [USN:L6N45M1A7 TEXT:"invest"] $1.34 billion to develop an EV plant in Argentina.
If Argentina's auto industry doesn’t transform, "it’s going to have obsolete cars," Beato said.
MILEI UNCONCERNED Chinese automakers are steadily expanding across Latin America, selling both traditional vehicles and EVs at a pace that has alarmed some local markets.
Brazil and Mexico have introduced tariffs aimed at slowing the influx and protecting domestic manufacturing jobs. But Milei, a libertarian, has said he is unconcerned by the rapid growth of BYD and dismissed suggestions that it could complicate his close relationship with the US during an interview last month.
"What Argentines buy is the problem of Argentines," Milei told Bloomberg at the Economic Club of New York.
Tesla in July launched operations in Uruguay, and there are signs the US automaker could soon enter Argentina.
The registration of Tesla Argentina appeared in the country's official gazette in April, and state energy company YPF said in June it had signed a letter of intent with Tesla to explore [USN:S0N41Q00Y TEXT:"energy storage"] opportunities.
Tesla did not respond to a request for comment.
'POSSIBILITY TO COMPETE' Car sales in Argentina have fallen 13% so far this year from the same period in 2025, a decline that industry analysts attribute to a market adjustment after last year's strong growth was fueled by lower trade barriers. High interest rates have also dissuaded consumers from taking out car loans.
Andres Civetta, an economist at consultancy Abeceb, said Argentina's auto industry should focus on pick-up trucks, where the country has established a strong export position and doesn't yet face competition from Chinese brands.
Fernando Rodriguez Canedo, executive director of Argentina's association of car factories, welcomed Milei's gradual rollback of national export duties and said the industry was also pressing provincial governments to reduce local taxes.
"That would give us the possibility to compete," Canedo said.

items.title: Sleepless on Wall Street: All-night stock exchanges coming soon
items.author: Bloomberg
items.summary: US equity exchanges will begin extended trading hours with an overnight session from 9 p.m. to 4 a.m. starting December 6. The changes aim to cater to growing foreign investor interest and compete with crypto markets. However, concerns about market liquidity and increased risks during these hours are prevalent among institutional investors. Pre-existing trading volumes suggest that institutional participation during night hours may be limited.
items.body: For decades, US equity exchanges have hit the pause button every night, leaving markets shut for several hours. Come December, the lights will stay on much longer as the stock market shifts toward around-the-clock trading.Nasdaq, NYSE Arca, 24X National Exchange and Cboe EDGX have crafted plans to add an overnight session from 9 p.m. to 4 a.m. in New York, on top of the regular hours and existing pre- and post-market periods they already operate. The expansion, set to take place on Dec. 6, seeks to capture growing demand from foreign investors while competing with crypto and prediction markets, which have upended traditional expectations of Wall Street’s operating hours.Overnight trading has existed for years, primarily through alternative trading systems, but it’s made up a tiny slice of the total activity — around 1% of equity trading volume in the second quarter, data presented at a Securities and Exchange Commission roundtable last week show. But while tiny next to daytime trading by any account, overnight trading is growing quickly, surging 358% from a year ago.The anticipated implementation of 23/5 trading has sparked a debate about what longer hours would mean for market participants worldwide. Proponents say the expansion will remove time-zone barriers and give foreign traders better access to US markets. Skeptics see lower liquidity and wider bid-ask spreads as amplifying trading risks.Institutional investors are mainly worried “about the market quality during the extended hours,” said David Easthope, a senior analyst at Crisil Coalition Greenwich, while concerns about operations and staffing are not necessarily at the top of their list.A survey of buy-side equity traders the firm conducted last year showed market participants were not eager to trade stocks around the clock. With fewer players active outside regular hours, investors could face lower trading volumes, thinner liquidity and wider bid-ask spreads. That could bring additional operational risk and complexity, or even affect traders’ own physical and mental health, the survey showed.The group’s sentiment has somewhat improved since the survey was conducted in the second part of 2025. There’s now “a greater sense of inevitability,” particularly as regulators move forward with the changes, Easthope said.The concept of overnight trading has been popular with retail investors and trading venues for years. Once the December changes kick in, “the usual suspects will be there and be ready,” said Brian Hyndman, chief executive officer of Blue Ocean Technologies, one of the ATS providers that currently facilitate overnight trading.“But I still think that we’re missing part of the industry, and that’s really the buy side and the investment banks,” he added. “They’ve been hesitant to get involved.”Key market infrastructure providers are also preparing for the shift. Depository Trust & Clearing Corp., the main firm responsible for clearing US stock trades, in June moved to a 24x5 model running from 8 p.m. New York time on Sunday to 8 p.m. New York time on Friday. Securities Information Processors, or SIPs, which collect and distribute quotes and trade data, also got a regulatory nod to extend their operating hours to support overnight trading.Proponents of the shift are likely betting on the idea that once the infrastructure is there, institutional demand will follow suit, said Joseph Saluzzi, partner and co-head of equity trading at Themis Trading LLC.Yet he’s skeptical about the transition.“Institutional investors have no interest in trading in a low liquidity, wide-spread market which is likely to be very volatile,” he said, adding that the combined volume of pre- and post-market trading on the exchanges accounts for just about 10% of the overall trading activity. “There’s actually a case, if you wanted to make it, that we have too many hours in the market, not too few.”For now, institutional investors remain in wait and see mode. If the Dec. 6 shift improves price discovery during late hours, the cost of trading will eventually drop, helping institutional money managers capture alpha during the night, according to Jeff O’Connor, Liquidnet’s head of market structure.Naturally, foreign investors are particularly active in late hours. They accounted for 37% of overnight trading volume in the second quarter, compared with just 7% for institutional accounts, according to the SEC data.That trading activity is also highly concentrated. In August, just 15 stocks on average were responsible for half of the total overnight volume, often including sub-dollar shares of companies domiciled in China and Hong Kong. By contrast, 256 stocks accounting for half the volume during the regular session.For now, Nasdaq and NYSE operate core sessions from 9:30 a.m. to 4 p.m. ET, five days a week. Those hours are supplemented by before- and after-hours sessions allowing limited types of trading starting as early as 4 a.m. and a post-market session from 4 p.m. to 8 p.m. After the December expansion, the exchanges will still have a one-hour break from 8 p.m. to 9 p.m. for maintenance and trade processing.

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ワシントン　２日　ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２日、韓国との通商合意に８４億ドル規模の石油増進回収（ＥＯＲ）プロジェクトが含まれると明らかにした。ただ、
items.body:
[ワシントン　２日　ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２日、韓国との通商合意に８４億ドル規模の石油増進回収（ＥＯＲ）プロジェクトが含まれると明らかにした。ただ、 韓国の聨合ニュースは産業通商資源省高官の話として、同プロジェクトは両国間の戦略的投資協定の一環ではないと報じた。

トランプ大統領は自身の交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」に「韓国との合意は一段と改善している！石油増進回収プロジェクトに８４億ドルが投じられる。石油・ガスの増産は、米国のエネルギー覇権と将来に向けた世界のエネルギー安全保障につながる！」と投稿した。

聨合ニュースの報道によると、韓国政府の当局者は米国側に問い合わせを行ったという。

トランプ氏は９月３０日、韓国が米国内の事業に約２０００億ドルを投資すると発表。ただ、韓国政府はその後、計画の柱の一つとされたアラスカ州の液化天然ガス（ＬＮＧ）事業向け５４０億ドル規模のパイプライン建設について、現時点で確定したものではないとの認識を示していた。

Oct 2 : Spain forward Ferran Torres has withdrawn from the national squad with an ankle issue and will be replaced by Carlos Espi for the upcoming Nations League matches, the Spanish Football Federation (RFEF) said on Friday.
Torres, who plays for Paris St Germain, has been troubled by minor discomfort in his left ankle and, despite training in recent days, was released from the squad to prioritise his recovery, the RFEF said.
Coach Luis de la Fuente called up Espi in his place, rewarding the Real Madrid youngster after he scored five goals and set up two more in Spain Under-21s' 13-0 rout of San Marino on Thursday.
"Due to the persistence of the symptoms, the decision was made to withdraw him from the squad to prioritise his recovery," the federation said in a statement, adding its medical staff had remained in constant contact with PSG throughout the camp.
Spain host the Czech Republic in Oviedo on Saturday before travelling to face Croatia on October 6.

[ワシントン　２日　ロイター] - 米商務省が２日発表した８月の製造業新規受注は前月比０．１％増の小幅な伸びにとどまった。電気機器・家電製品・同部品への強い需要があったものの、低調な民間航空機の受注に相殺された。ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は０．１％増だった。

７月は０．９％増から０．８％増に下方改定された。

８月は前年同月比では６．８％増加した。

人工知能（ＡＩ）インフラの拡充に加え、堅調な国内需要に対応するため企業が在庫を再構築していることが製造業の下支えとなっている。ただ、米国とイスラエルによるイランとの戦争がサプライチェーン（供給網）を混乱させ、エネルギー価格を押し上げている中で、ＡＩ投資ブームと関連性の薄い分野は今後数カ月間、苦戦を強いられる可能性があるとの懸念もある。

８月は、民間航空機・同部品の受注が４．３％減少したことが重しとなった。自動車車体・同部品・トレーラーの受注は０．８％増。機械受注は１．１％増加した。コンピューター・電子製品の受注は横ばいだった一方、前年同月比では１４．７％増加した。電気機器・家電製品・同部品の受注は１．１％急増した。 

企業の設備投資計画の指標とされる航空機を除く非国防資本財（コア資本財）の受注は１．６％増と、先月発表の速報値から変わらずだった。コア資本財の出荷は０．５％増と、当初発表の０．６％増から下方改定された。

FAST

Oct 2 : Football Leaks whistleblower Rui Pinto is set to lose his witness protection status in Portugal, his legal team said on Friday, days after an independent commission found Manchester City guilty of serious breaches of the Premier League's financial rules.
Pinto, whose disclosures helped trigger scrutiny of Manchester City's finances, entered Portugal's witness protection programme in 2020 after agreeing to cooperate with authorities and provide files obtained through the Football Leaks operation.
City were found guilty of all charges relating to breaches of Premier League financial regulations over nine seasons from 2009-10 to 2017-18, as well as three of four charges concerning failures to cooperate with the investigation.
The league said this week that City had used "sham" commercial contracts to inflate revenue and understate costs by more than 900 million pounds ($1.19 billion) over nearly a decade, resulting in inaccurate financial reporting and breaches of spending rules.

The club have denied wrongdoing and appealed the verdict.
"In a few days, without being heard beforehand, as required by law, he would lose the protected, confidential residence assigned to him and be forced to find new housing urgently, with no guarantee that police protection will continue," Pinto's legal team said in a statement posted on his X account.
"His situation is now critical. The threats against him are not merely theoretical; he was assaulted in Lisbon last April."
FOOTBALL LEAKS
Launched in 2015, Football Leaks published millions of confidential documents from the football industry, including transfer agreements, contracts and other deals involving clubs, players and agents.
Football Leaks' data seen by Reuters showed how some of the richest and most prominent figures in soccer avoided tax by channelling earnings offshore.
Pinto was arrested in Hungary in 2019 before being extradited to Portugal, where he later cooperated with authorities and was placed under witness protection.
His lawyers said the programme would end on October 10 and argued the decision leaves him at heightened risk, noting legal proceedings stemming from the leaks remained ongoing, including the recent Manchester City case.
"If abruptly deprived of his protected housing and plunged into a state of extreme precariousness, Rui Pinto would be more vulnerable now than at any time since 2020," the statement said.
Portugal's Justice Ministry did not immediately respond to a request for comment on Friday.

Source: Reuters

items.title: 欧州がディーゼル備蓄放出で合意、トランプ氏　価格抑制へ米が圧力
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ワシントン　２日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[ワシントン　２日　ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２日、イラン戦争を背景とした燃料価格の高騰を抑制するよう求める米国の圧力を受け、欧州がディーゼル（軽油）燃料の備蓄を放出することで合意したと明らかにした。

トランプ大統領は「欧州は大量に備蓄しているディーゼルを大規模に放出することに合意した。手続きは直ちに開始される」と自身の交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」に投稿した。

関係筋の１人がロイターに語ったところによると、米国はフランスやドイツを含む欧州の主要国に対し、２０日以内に１億バレルのディーゼルを放出するよう要求した。

フランスのエリゼ宮（大統領府）によると、マクロン仏大統領は１日夜、トランプ大統領と電話会談を行い、燃料価格の高騰に対処し、精製石油製品の世界的な供給を確保するために協力する必要性を強調した。こうした中、ＥＵ加盟国は２日、欧州諸国が５０００万バレルのディーゼルを、国際エネルギー機関（ＩＥＡ）加盟国が５０００万バレルの原油を放出するという仏の提案について協議したと関係筋は話している。

マクロン仏大統領はその後、主要７カ国（Ｇ７）首脳とのビデオ会議を開催し、エネルギー情勢について協議した。

items.title: Israeli officials to question co-pilot of flydubai flight, source says
items.author: Alexander Cornwell
items.creator: Alexander Cornwell
items.summary: Israeli officials are expected to question the co-pilot who allegedly attempted to crash a commercial passenger flight from Dubai bound for Tel Aviv, according to a source briefed on the investigation.
items.body:
Israeli officials are expected to question the co-pilot who allegedly attempted to crash a commercial [USN:L6N45N0GW TEXT:"passenger flight"] from Dubai bound for Tel Aviv, according to a source briefed on the investigation.
Disaster was averted on [USN:L4N45N0NH TEXT:"flydubai"] flight FZ1073 on Wednesday after passengers and crew subdued the co-pilot, who had [USN:L1N45M07P TEXT:"stabbed"] the captain in what Israeli officials have said was an apparent attempt to crash the plane carrying over 170 passengers and crew.
A reserve flydubai pilot crew travelling on the flight landed the plane at Tabuk airport in northwestern Saudi Arabia, where the co-pilot was detained by Saudi Arabian authorities.
The co-pilot was transferred on Thursday to the UAE, where the source said Israeli officials were expected to question him.
The source declined to say which Israeli agency or authority would take part in the questioning.
Asked whether Israeli officials would question the co-pilot, an Israeli government official told Reuters that Israeli investigators would take part in the UAE-led investigation alongside Emirati authorities, seeking to determine what happened and examine the suspect's motives and background.
The UAE foreign ministry did not immediately respond to a request for comment on whether Israeli officials would question the co-pilot.
In his first public comments on the incident, flydubai Chief Executive Ghaith Al Ghaith said on Friday that authorities were conducting an official investigation, supported by the airline, after what he described as a "safety incident" in the cockpit.
"It is important that we allow this process to establish the facts," he said in a written statement, acknowledging that there were "many questions" about what happened on flight FZ1073.
The UAE state news agency reported on Thursday that Emirati authorities had opened an investigation seeking to establish the circumstances and motives and determine "whether the incident was linked to any terrorist activity or purpose, or involved prior planning or direction".
MOTIVE NOT YET ESTABLISHED Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said on Friday that Israel was looking into whether the co-pilot had acted under anyone's direction, warning in a video statement released by his office that whoever was involved would pay a "heavy price".
Most of the passengers on board were Israeli nationals.
Netanyahu on Thursday said that the co-pilot, whom he has identified as an Omani national, had undergone radical Islamist indoctrination and was clearly suicidal, but that so far a motive for his actions had not been established.
Israel does not have official diplomatic relations with Oman, and Netanyahu has said pilots from such countries were not permitted to operate flights to Israel. It was not clear how the co-pilot came to be assigned to the flight to Tel Aviv.
The aircraft plunged some 16,625 feet in just over 30 seconds as it flew over Saudi Arabia on the journey from the United Arab Emirates to Israel, according to data from flight tracker Flightradar24. The route is popular among Israelis.
CAPTAIN HAILED AS HERO The co-pilot's identity has not been publicly disclosed beyond his nationality. The captain who was stabbed has been identified as Indian national [USN:L4N45M1MF TEXT:"Smit Machchhar"], who has been [USN:L1N45N01H TEXT:"hailed"] as a hero by Netanyahu and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
Omani authorities have not commented on the incident.
The incident heightened security fears in Israel weeks before Israelis vote on October 27, in the first general election since the Hamas-led attacks on October 7, 2023, with Israel's security featuring prominently in the campaigning.
The US and Israel launched strikes against Iran in February, in a war that quickly spread to the Gulf and Lebanon, where Israel has been fighting Iran-backed militant group Hezbollah.
Since coming under attack by Iran this year, the UAE has strengthened its relationships with Israel, with which it opened ties as a result of the 2020 Abraham Accords.

WASHINGTON: US job growth slowed more than expected in September and the nonfarm payrolls count for the prior two months was revised sharply lower, almost taking another interest rate hike from the Federal Reserve this month off the table.
The Labor Department's closely watched employment report on Friday (Oct 2) also showed the unemployment rate increased to 4.2 per cent last month from 4.1 per cent in August as more people entered the workforce. The sharp moderation in job growth likely does not mark a sudden deterioration in labour market conditions.
Economists noted that payrolls have a tendency to underperform when the Labor Day holiday falls relatively late in September, as was the case this year. There have been no signs of a broad increase in layoffs. First-time applications for unemployment benefits have been hovering at 57-year lows amid robust corporate profit growth and resilient domestic demand.
Economists said the report reaffirmed the labour market's "low-hire, low-fire" state and likely had no impact on near-term monetary policy, with inflation remaining the key focus.

"This is a disappointing jobs report and a reminder that the low-hire, low-fire labour market never went away," said Olu Sonola, head of US economics at Fitch Ratings. "Weak job growth, a slightly higher unemployment rate, contained wage gains and downward revisions to earlier payroll estimates give the Fed little reason to keep an October rate hike on the table. But CPI remains the report that matters most."
Nonfarm payrolls increased by 29,000 jobs last month after a downwardly revised rise of 133,000 in August, the Labor Department's Bureau of Labor Statistics said. Economists polled by Reuters had forecast payrolls would advance by 90,000 after a previously reported surge of 162,000 in August. Estimates ranged from as low as 35,000 to as high as 180,000.
The data for July was revised to show the economy shed 10,000 jobs, the second time this year that payrolls turned negative.
All told, the economy added 60,000 fewer jobs in July and August than previously estimated. Volatility linked to the model the government uses to strip out seasonal fluctuations from the data likely accounted for both the meagre payroll gains last month and the downward revision to the count for August.
Economists, however, said they expected growing headwinds from the US-Israel war with Iran, including high energy prices and strained supply chains, would start disrupting the labour market by the end of this year and into 2027.
Diesel prices are at record highs and could start to exert pressure beyond the transportation and agricultural sectors. Ongoing tariffs also are a source of concern, with an Institute for Supply Management survey on Thursday showing rising anxiety among manufacturers over the trade war with Canada.
HEALTHCARE PAYROLLS RISE MARGINALLY Healthcare continued to account for the bulk of the job growth, adding 17,000 positions, a figure that was well below the average monthly gain of 33,000 in the past 12 months. Those job gains occurred in ambulatory healthcare services and at hospitals. Employment in nursing and residential care facilities dropped by 9,000 positions, which could be related to the termination of Temporary Protected Status for hundreds of thousands of Haitian immigrants.
Construction payrolls increased by 11,000, while manufacturers added 9,000. Financial activities employment dropped by 7,000 positions. Despite job growth almost stalling last month, the average workweek was unchanged at 34.4 hours.
Financial markets further reduced bets on a rate hike at the US central bank's Oct 27-28 meeting to roughly 13 per cent, down from 22 per cent prior to the report and about 69 per cent a week ago, CME Group's FedWatch tool showed. The odds of further monetary policy tightening had already been diminished by cooler-than-expected inflation readings for August and July.
The Fed last month raised its benchmark overnight interest rate by 25 basis points to the 3.75-4.00 per cent range, the first hike in three years, and flagged further increases in borrowing costs ahead. With inflation still above the central bank's 2 per cent target, economists continued to expect a rate hike in December.
US stocks opened higher. The dollar slipped against a basket of currencies. US Treasury yields were mostly lower.
The rise in the unemployment rate reflected a jump of 485,000 in the labour force. This lifted the labour force participation rate to 61.8 per cent last month from 61.6 per cent in August. Household employment increased by 406,000.

Source: Reuters/ec

items.title: Retornos bonos Tesoro EEUU suben, revierten reacción inicial tras débil dato empleo
items.author: Sinead Carew
items.creator: Sinead Carew
items.summary: Los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos revirtieron sus caídas iniciales el viernes, a medida que los inversores asimilaban un informe de empleo de septiembre más débil de lo previsto y que moderó las apuestas sobre subidas de tasas de interés por parte de la Reserva Federal.
items.body:
Los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro de Estados Unidos revirtieron sus caídas iniciales el viernes, a medida que los inversores asimilaban un informe de empleo de septiembre más débil de lo previsto y que moderó las apuestas sobre subidas de tasas de interés por parte de la Reserva Federal.
* La economía estadounidense creó 29.000 puestos de trabajo en septiembre, frente a los 90.000 previstos, según el informe del Departamento de Trabajo, que también situó la tasa de desempleo de septiembre en el 4,2%, por encima del 4,1% previsto por los economistas. El crecimiento del empleo en agosto se revisó a la baja, pasando de los 162.000 puestos comunicados previamente a 133.000.
* Aunque inicialmente los inversores reaccionaron al informe comprando bonos del Tesoro de forma generalizada, posteriormente se reanudaron las ventas, lo que puso de manifiesto las numerosas fuentes de tensión que pesan actualmente sobre este mercado: desde un crecimiento económico sólido y una elevada emisión de deuda hasta los temores inflacionarios.
* Los operadores descontaban una probabilidad de alrededor del 80% de que las tasas de interés se mantengan sin cambios en la reunión de este mes, frente al 74% previo a los datos. Las expectativas de un alza en diciembre oscilaron en torno al 86%, según datos de LSEG.
* Sobre la reversión de los retornos tras la reacción inicial, Molly Brooks, estratega de tasas de interés en Estados Unidos para TD Securities, apuntó a las fluctuaciones en las expectativas sobre la política monetaria de la Fed durante la sesión, así como a la toma de ganancias y al reposicionamiento de carteras de cara al fin de semana.
* En el conjunto de la semana, la rentabilidad a dos años cayó 3,3 puntos básicos, en su primer descenso semanal desde la segunda semana de agosto. El rendimiento de referencia a 10 años anotó a una subida semanal de 10 puntos básicos, su quinto avance semanal consecutivo. El retorno a 30 años acumuló un incremento semanal de 13,2 puntos básicos, el segundo ascenso seguido.
* Tras los descensos previos, el rendimiento a 10 años subió 4,72 puntos básicos (pb), al 5,281%; el de las notas a 30 años sumó 2,91 pb, al 5,6321%; y el de la deuda a dos años , que suele moverse en línea con las expectativas sobre tasas de la Fed, avanzó 3,98 pb, al 4,827%.
* Un segmento muy seguido de la curva, que mide la diferencia entre las tasas a dos y 10 años y es considerado un indicador de las expectativas económicas, se situó en 45,2 puntos básicos.

items.title: テスラの世界納車、第3四半期は市場予想上回る　欧州で需要回復
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Anhata Rooprai　Akash Sriram

[２日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Anhata Rooprai　Akash Sriram

[２日　ロイター] - 米電気自動車（ＥＶ）大手テスラが２日発表した第３・四半期（７─９月期）の世界納車台数は４８万６５３２台と、市場予想を上回った。欧州での需要回復が、米国での税制優遇措置の失効や中国での競争激化による影響を相殺した。

同社の株価は午前の取引で約４％超上昇した。

ビジブル・アルファがまとめたアナリスト予想平均は４５万６８９６台だった。今年初めとは異なり、アナリストらは納車台数の通年予想を引き上げている。２０２６年の納車台数は１８２万台と、６月時点のコンセンサス予想の１６５万台から上方修正した。

ただ、納車台数が３年連続で前年比減となる事態を回避するには、同社は第４・四半期に少なくとも３１万１４４８台を納車する必要がある。

欧州では昨年、イーロン・マスク最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の政治的言動への反発などから販売が低迷したものの、欧州連合（ＥＵ）での新車登録台数は８月までで約３分の２増加。フランスでは「モデルＹ」が全車種を通じて最も売れた車となった。

モーニングスターのアナリスト、セス・ゴールドスタイン氏は「この堅調な数字により、テスラは２年連続の減少を経て、通年の納車台数が増加に転じる軌道に乗った。ＦＳＤ（完全自動運転）が、消費者が他の自動車メーカーではなくテスラを選ぶ決め手となっている」と述べた。

テスラの第３・四半期の車両生産台数は４６万４３９１台で、予想の４８万６７６１台を下回った。

[２日　ロイター] - 米電気自動車（ＥＶ）大手テスラが２日発表した第３・四半期（７─９月期）の世界納車台数は４８万６５３２台と、市場予想を上回った。欧州での需要回復が、米国での税制優遇措置の失効や中国での競争激化による影響を相殺した。

同社の株価は午前の取引で約４％超上昇した。

ビジブル・アルファがまとめたアナリスト予想平均は４５万６８９６台だった。今年初めとは異なり、アナリストらは納車台数の通年予想を引き上げている。２０２６年の納車台数は１８２万台と、６月時点のコンセンサス予想の１６５万台から上方修正した。

ただ、納車台数が３年連続で前年比減となる事態を回避するには、同社は第４・四半期に少なくとも３１万１４４８台を納車する必要がある。

欧州では昨年、イーロン・マスク最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の政治的言動への反発などから販売が低迷したものの、欧州連合（ＥＵ）での新車登録台数は８月までで約３分の２増加。フランスでは「モデルＹ」が全車種を通じて最も売れた車となった。

モーニングスターのアナリスト、セス・ゴールドスタイン氏は「この堅調な数字により、テスラは２年連続の減少を経て、通年の納車台数が増加に転じる軌道に乗った。ＦＳＤ（完全自動運転）が、消費者が他の自動車メーカーではなくテスラを選ぶ決め手となっている」と述べた。

テスラの第３・四半期の車両生産台数は４６万４３９１台で、予想の４８万６７６１台を下回った。

RIJEKA, Croatia, Oct 2 : Manchester City's guilty verdict for serious breaches of the Premier League's financial rules has become a major topic of discussion in the England camp, manager Thomas Tuchel said before Saturday's Nations League match against Croatia.
City were found guilty by an independent commission of all charges relating to financial rule breaches over nine seasons from 2009-10 to 2017-18, as well as three of four charges concerning failures to cooperate with the investigation.
The club, who have denied wrongdoing throughout the process, appealed against the commission's ruling on Friday as they seek to overturn the verdict and avoid potentially severe sanctions.
Midfielder Elliot Anderson and centre back Marc Guehi are among the City players in the England squad, while left back Nico O'Reilly returned to the club because of injury.

Asked whether the verdict was being discussed by the players and whether he had spoken to City's contingent, Tuchel told reporters on Friday: "I guess so. We had some time off between the matches and it is a big subject.
"Everyone speaks about it, so there is no other voice needed. I am glad to be not that voice. No one needs my half knowledge on the topic.
"Of course, the players talk about it. City players talk about it. We talk with them but only briefly. They are ready to go tomorrow. But of course, it's a big topic in the camp."
Tuchel was also asked whether he would continue selecting City players if the club were relegated from the Premier League.
"There is always a possibility," the German said.
"I would always try to pick the best team for the camp, occasion, the tournament. I will never rule out that because they don't play in the top flight in their country.
"We need to look at it case by case."
England are second in Group A3 with three points from two matches, having lost 3-2 to Spain at Wembley before beating the Czech Republic 2-0 in Prague on Tuesday.
They face Croatia in the port city of Rijeka, where the match will be played behind closed doors following crowd disturbances involving Croatia supporters during a Nations League quarter-final against France in March 2025.
"It has made a huge difference for us to have three days in between so that we could take care of players with high output like Anderson and Gordon, for example," Tuchel said.
"Everyone has been at training today except for O'Reilly, who had to leave camp to get treatment and leave as soon as possible. His discomfort was too painful and he couldn't be on the pitch.
"Everyone else started and ended training today on a high level."

Source: Reuters

items.title: Trump expected to name Jay Clayton as AI czar
items.author: Erin Banco
items.creator: Erin Banco
items.summary: US President Donald Trump is expected to name Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton to be his top adviser on AI, a position the president has called "AI czar" in the past, according to a source familiar with the decision.
items.body:
US President Donald Trump is expected to name Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton to be his top adviser on AI, a position the president has called "AI czar" in the past, according to a source familiar with the decision.
Clayton already oversees 18 US intelligence agencies as the nation's top spy and is expected to keep that role.
"Any personnel announcement will be announced directly by the president," a White House official said in a statement to Reuters when asked about Clayton being selected for the position. "Any reporting until then is baseless speculation."
Trump's decision to name a new AI czar comes after AI researchers warned that people building the technology believe it could kill humans within a decade. Trump last month said he planned to name a new "AI czar" and create an "AI force," though he gave no details about either initiative or how they would be implemented.
This is the second time Trump has named an adviser to oversee AI-related decisions across the administration. Venture capitalist David Sacks held the AI czar role at the beginning of Trump's second term, before leaving the White House. Sacks still advises Trump on AI and attended a meeting on Tuesday with the president and industry executives.
The news of an AI czar was first reported by CBS.

items.title: 米10月利上げ観測後退、雇用統計軟調で＝金利先物市場
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[２日　ロイター] - ２日発表の米雇用統計から労働市場が予想以上に減速していることが明らかとなり、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の当局者はインフレ抑制に向けた追加利上げを先送りするさらなる理由を得る形となった。

米労働省労働統計局が発表した９月の雇用統計によると、非農業部門雇用者数は２万９０００人増で、前月から伸びが鈍化し市場予想を下回った。失業率は４．２％で前月の４．１％から上昇した。今回の統計は、トランプ大統領率いる共和党が、連邦議会上下両院の支配権を維持できるかどうかを左右する１１月の中間選挙前の、労働市場に関する最後の広範な指標となる。 

雇用統計発表後、金利先物市場が織り込む、ＦＲＢが１０月の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で利上げに踏み切る確率は６分の１未満と、これまでの４分の１超から低下した。１２月の利上げ観測も後退したものの、年内の利上げ実施は高い確率で織り込まれている。

ＦＲＢは先月開いたＦＯＭＣで、インフレ率を２％目標に戻すため３年２カ月ぶりとなる利上げを決定した。当局者らは、イラン戦争やその他のインフレ押し上げ要因となるショックが続く場合、労働市場が安定を保つ限り、年内に少なくともあと１回の利上げを実施する可能性が高いとの姿勢を示していた。

フィフス・サードのエコノミスト、ビル・アダムズ氏は「９月の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）と卸売物価指数（ＰＰＩ）、ガソリン価格、そして１０月の次回ＦＯＭＣまでの地政学的動向の方が、今回の雇用統計よりも次回の金利決定に大きな影響を与えるだろう」と述べた。

items.title: Minutes from disaster: Inside the flydubai flight as it plunged from the sky
items.author: Vijdan Kawoosa, Adrián Blanco
items.creator: Vijdan Kawoosa, Adrián Blanco
items.summary: Minute by minute tracking data shows how the Flydubai jet plunged over Saudi Arabia, recovered and diverted to Tabuk.
items.body:
Passengers and crew on a flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv on September 30 foiled what Israeli officials said was an attempt by the co-pilot to crash the aircraft, averting disaster. A reserve crew then took control and landed the plane in Saudi Arabia.
Click here to read more.
Flydubai flight 1073, carrying 174 passengers and crew members, departed Dubai for Tel Aviv at 7:05 a.m. local time (0305 GMT), and was cruising at 34,000 feet over Saudi Arabia.
Limited three-dimensional tracking data from Flightradar24 shows the aircraft turned right and fell more than 16,000 feet in just over 30 seconds.
The aircraft pulled up and recovered some altitude before dropping again.
While the exact sequence of events remains unclear, the co-pilot stabbed the captain in what Israeli officials said was an apparent attempt to crash the plane.
About eight minutes after the first plunge, the plane transmitted squawk 7700, the code for a general emergency.
About six minutes after that, the squawk changed to 7500, the code for unlawful interference.
The aircraft entered Jordanian airspace and then turned back toward Saudi Arabia.
More than an hour later, the flight landed safely at Tabuk airport in Saudi Arabia.
More detailed two dimensional flight data shows the aircraft’s movements were even more erratic. In just a few minutes, the plane that had been cruising smoothly at 34,000 feet lurched into violent climbs and dives, shed some 17,000 feet of altitude, and surged to nearly 600 knots of ground speed, about 45% faster than its normal cruising pace, before slowly steadying itself.
Although the Flydubai 1073 aircraft recovered from the plunge, its initial descent was strikingly steep. The trajectory can be compared with the rapid descents of aircraft involved in several major crashes, a Reuters analysis showed.
At its steepest point, the plane was losing altitude at about 544 feet (166 metres) per second, roughly equivalent to the height of 44 storeys of the Empire State Building every second.
The wounded captain managed to unlock the cockpit door, allowing passengers to subdue the attacker, Israeli officials said. A reserve crew that had been aboard landed the plane at Tabuk airport in Saudi Arabia.
Flydubai said on Wednesday the circumstances surrounding the incident are still being investigated. Reuters was not able to contact the co-pilot, who has been detained.

items.title: David Ellison says combined Paramount and Warner Bros Discovery will be named Skydance
items.author: Anzar Mehraj
items.creator: Anzar Mehraj
items.summary: Paramount Skydance CEO David Ellison on Friday said upon closing the company's merger with Warner Bros Discovery, the combined entity will be called Skydance.
items.body:
Paramount Skydance CEO David Ellison on Friday said upon closing the company's merger with Warner Bros Discovery, the combined entity will be called Skydance.
The move was aimed at maintaining separate identities of the Paramount (PSKY.O) and Warner Bros (WBD.O) studios, rather than have a new corporate identity overshadow them, Ellison added.
The combined company will be an entertainment behemoth spanning film, TV and news, uniting the studios behind the "Mission: Impossible" and "Harry Potter" films with major television and streaming networks such as CBS, CNN, Paramount+ and HBO Max.
"We never wanted a new corporate identity to diminish, alter or overshadow either one," Ellison wrote in a social media post. "Instead, we wanted a name that would give the combined company an identity of its own while allowing Paramount and Warner Bros — and all our extraordinary brands — to remain in the spotlight."
The company plans to change its legal name to Skydance Corporation on October 6, according to a regulatory filing. On the same day, its Class B shares are expected to move from Nasdaq to the New York Stock Exchange, where they will trade under the ticker "SKYD" instead of "PSKY."
"The name is ego-driven. It reminds everyone that the most iconic Hollywood brands answer to Ellison and it is his company who won out," said Ross Benes, senior analyst at Emarketer.
A US judge on Wednesday entered an order allowing Paramount Skydance to close its $110 billion acquisition of Warner Bros Discovery, ending a months-long holdup.
The order approved a [USN:L4N45D112 TEXT:"September 21 settlement"] with a California-led group of 12 states that had sued to block the merger, arguing it would create a media giant capable of driving up film and TV prices.
Ellison earlier this week named [USN:L6N45M19T TEXT:"Ynon Kreiz as his co-CEO"], tasking the Mattel CEO with running day-to-day operations and leading the integration, freeing him up to helm creative direction and overall strategy.
The duo faces a target of saving $6 billion in costs while managing roughly $80 billion in combined debt.

items.title: 米9月雇用者数2.9万人増に鈍化、失業率4.2％　利上げ観測後退
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Lucia Mutikani

[ワシントン ２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Lucia Mutikani

[ワシントン ２日 ロイター] - 米労働省労働統計局が２日発表した９月の雇用統計によると、非農業部門雇用者数は２万９０００人増で、前月から伸びが鈍化し市場予想を下回った。過去２カ月分も大幅に下方改定された。米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が今月の米連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で追加利上げに踏み切る可能性はほぼなくなったとみられる。

失業率は４．２％で、前月の４．１％から上昇した。労働市場に参入する人が増えたことが背景。ただ、非農業部門雇用者数の伸びの急減速は、労働市場の急激な悪化を示すものではないとみられる。

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想は９万人増、予想レンジは３万５０００─１８万人増だった。

８月の非農業部門雇用者数は１６万２０００人増から１３万３０００人増に、７月は２万１０００人増から１万人減に下方改定された。雇用者数が減少したのは２６年に入って２回目。７、８月の雇用者数は合計で従来推計を６万人下回った。過去３カ月間の雇用増加数は月平均５万１０００人増で、２０２５年の同時期の２万３０００人を上回った。

エコノミストは、今回の統計が労働市場の「採用も解雇も少ない」状態を改めて示したと指摘。インフレが最大の焦点となる中、目先の金融政策には影響しない可能性が高いとの見方を示した。

フィッチ・レーティングスの米経済責任者、オル・ソノラ氏は「失望を誘う雇用統計であり、採用も解雇も少ない労働市場が続いていたことを再認識させる内容だ」と指摘。「雇用の伸び悩み、失業率の小幅上昇、抑制された賃金の伸び、過去の雇用者数の下方改定を踏まえると、ＦＲＢが１０月の利上げを選択肢に残す理由はほとんどない。ただ、引き続き最も重要な統計は消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）だ」と述べた。

９月の低調な伸びと８月分の下方改定は、政府が季節的な変動を取り除くために用いる季節調整モデルに関連する変動が原因とみられる。エコノミストは、今年のようにレーバーデーの祝日が例年より遅めのときは、雇用の伸びが低調になる傾向があると指摘した。人員削減が広範に増加している兆候はない。企業利益の堅調な伸びと底堅い国内需要を背景に、新規失業保険申請件数は５７年ぶりの低水準で推移している。

ただエコノミストは、エネルギー価格の高騰や供給網の逼迫など、米国とイスラエルによる対イラン戦争に伴う逆風が強まり、２６年末から２７年にかけて労働市場に支障が生じ始めると予想した。

＜医療部門の雇用、小幅増にとどまる＞

医療部門は引き続き雇用増の大半を占め、１万７０００人増加した。ただ、過去１２カ月の月平均増加数３万３０００人を大きく下回った。外来医療サービスと病院で雇用が増加した一方、看護・居住型介護施設では９０００人減少した。ハイチ出身の移民数十万人を対象とする一時保護資格（ＴＰＳ）の終了が関係している可能性がある。

建設業は１万１０００人増、製造業は９０００人増だった。情報関連業は１万人、金融業は７０００人、それぞれ減少した。専門・ビジネスサービス業は人材派遣業の１万０９００人減を受けて９０００人減少した。一方、レジャー・接客業は１万人増。卸売業・小売業や運輸・倉庫業でも緩やかな雇用増がみられた。

雇用増を報告した業種の割合は４９．０％と８月の５７．６％から低下し、過去１１カ月で最も低い水準に落ち込んだ。

９月の雇用の伸びはほぼ止まったものの、週平均労働時間は３４．４時間で変わらなかった。

平均時給は０．１％上昇と、８月の０．３％上昇から伸びが縮小した。前年比でも３．０％上昇と、８月の３．１％上昇から鈍化した。

失業率の上昇は、労働力人口が４８万５０００人増加したことを反映した。これに伴い、労働参加率は８月の６１．６％から９月は６１．８％に上昇した。家計調査に基づく就業者数は４０万６０００人増加した。

ＢＭＯキャピタル・マーケッツのチーフ米国エコノミスト、スコット・アンダーソン氏は「今回の統計には労働市場が深刻な危機に陥っていることを示唆する要素は何もないが、労働市場の底堅さは国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）成長率ほど確固たる基盤には立っていない可能性が高い」と述べた。

ＣＭＥグループのフェドウオッチによると、金融市場が織り込む１０月２７─２８日の米連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）での利上げ確率は当初約１３％に低下したものの、その後、約２３％と前日とほぼ同じ水準となった。

items.title: Brazil's Petrobras makes new oil discovery off Amapa state
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Brazilian state-run oil company Petrobras said on Friday it had made a new oil discovery in ultra-deep waters off Amapa state, part of a region known as Equatorial Margin that it considers its most promising new oil frontier.
items.body:
Brazilian state-run oil company Petrobras (PETR3.SA) said on Friday it had made a new oil discovery in ultra-deep waters off Amapa state, part of a region known as Equatorial Margin that it considers its most promising new oil frontier.
According to a securities filing, an oil-bearing interval was found in the Morpho well, marking a new discovery in block FZA-M-59, where it had already [USN:S0N44906J TEXT:"identified hydrocarbons"] in August.
Discovery was made in a second reservoir, deeper in the same well of the August oil discovery, according to the company
Work on the well is expected to conclude by end of October, CEO Magda Chambriard told reporters on Friday
Petrobras will drill [USN:L1N44W0HV TEXT:"three new wells"] in the area to determine wether commercial production in the environmentally-sensitive Foz do Amazonas basin is viable
Petrobras has seven wells still to be licensed for drilling in the region, said Chambriard
Foz do Amazonas shares geological similarities with offshore Guyana, where ExxonMobil (XOM.N) is developing huge fields

items.title: US job growth undershoots expectations in September, but labor market remains stable
items.author: Lucia Mutikani
items.creator: Lucia Mutikani
items.summary: US job growth slowed more than expected in September and the nonfarm payrolls count for the prior two months was revised sharply lower, almost taking another interest rate hike from the Federal Reserve this month off the table.
items.body:
US job growth slowed more than expected in September and the nonfarm payrolls count for the prior two months was revised sharply lower, almost taking another interest rate hike from the Federal Reserve this month off the table.
The Labor Department's closely watched employment report on Friday also showed the unemployment rate increased to 4.2% last month from 4.1% in August as more people entered the workforce. The sharp moderation in job growth likely does not mark a sudden deterioration in labor market conditions.
Economists noted that payrolls have a tendency to underperform when the Labor Day holiday falls relatively late in September, as was the case this year. There have been no signs of a broad increase in layoffs. First-time applications for [USN:L1N45N0HR TEXT:"unemployment benefits"] have been hovering at 57-year lows amid robust corporate profit growth and resilient domestic demand.
Economists said the report reaffirmed the labor market's "low-hire, low-fire" state and likely had no impact on near-term monetary policy, with inflation remaining the key focus.
"This is a disappointing jobs report and a reminder that the low-hire, low-fire labor market never went away," said Olu Sonola, head of US economics at Fitch Ratings. "Weak job growth, a slightly higher unemployment rate, contained wage gains and downward revisions to earlier payroll estimates give the Fed little reason to keep an October rate hike on the table."
Nonfarm payrolls increased by 29,000 jobs last month after a downwardly revised rise of 133,000 in August, the Labor Department's Bureau of Labor Statistics said. Economists polled by Reuters had forecast payrolls would advance by 90,000 after a previously reported surge of 162,000 in August. Estimates ranged from as low as 35,000 to as high as 180,000.
The survey of establishments showed the data for July was revised to show the economy shed 10,000 jobs, the second time this year that payrolls turned negative. All told, the economy added 60,000 fewer jobs in July and August than previously estimated. Volatility linked to the model the government uses to strip out seasonal fluctuations from the data likely accounted for both the meager payroll gains last month and the downward revisions to July and August.
Job growth averaged 51,000 per month over the past three months compared to 23,000 during the same period in 2025. Economists estimated that the economy needs to create roughly 50,000 jobs per month to keep up with growth in the working-age population. The so-called break-even rate for payrolls reflects a sharp reduction in labor supply because of retirements and the Trump administration's immigration crackdown.
Economists, however, said they expected growing headwinds from the US-Israeli war with Iran , including high energy prices and strained supply chains, would start disrupting the labor market by the end of this year and into 2027.
Diesel prices are at record highs and could start to exert pressure beyond the transportation and agricultural sectors. Ongoing tariffs also are a source of concern, with an [USN:S0N44H001 TEXT:"Institute for Supply Management"] survey on Thursday showing rising anxiety among manufacturers over the trade war with Canada.
Financial markets initially lowered bets on a rate hike at the US central bank's October 27-28 meeting to 13% before lifting them to about 23%, little changed from Thursday, CME Group's FedWatch tool showed.
The odds of further monetary policy tightening had already been slashed from about 70% at the start of the week by cooler-than-expected [USN:L1N45M0L0 TEXT:"inflation readings"] for August and July.
The Fed [USN:L6N4570XW TEXT:"last month raised"] its benchmark overnight interest rate by 25 basis points to the 3.75%-4.00% range, the first hike in three years, and flagged further increases in borrowing costs ahead. With inflation still above its 2% target, economists continued to expect a rate hike in December. Stocks on Wall Street were higher. The dollar eased against a basket of currencies. US Treasury yields rose after initially falling.
WAGE GAINS SLOW Healthcare continued to account for the bulk of the job growth, adding 17,000 positions, a figure that was well below the average monthly gain of 33,000 in the past 12 months. Those job increases occurred in ambulatory healthcare services and at hospitals. Employment in nursing and residential care facilities dropped by 9,000 positions, which could be related to the termination of Temporary Protected Status for hundreds of thousands of Haitian immigrants.
Construction payrolls increased by 11,000, lifted by hiring of nonresidential specialty trade contractors. That could be related to the building of infrastructure to support AI. The AI spending boom likely also accounted for the 9,000 rise in manufacturing jobs. Factory employment has risen 72,000 since bottoming out last December.
Leisure and hospitality payrolls rose 10,000. There were modest job gains in the wholesale and retail trade sectors as well as the transportation and warehousing industry.
Information payrolls dropped by 10,000, while the financial activities sector shed 7,000 positions. Professional and business services employment decreased by 9,000 amid a drop of 10,900 in temporary help services. The mining and logging industry lost jobs. Government payrolls contracted 17,000, mostly in local government, excluding education.
The share of industries reporting job growth dropped to an 11-month low of 49.0% from 57.6% in August. Still, the average workweek was unchanged at 34.4 hours.
Wage growth, however, cooled. Average hourly earnings edged up 0.1% after rising 0.3% in August. That lowered the annual increase in wages to 3.0% from 3.1% in August.
Slower wage growth confirmed the labor market was not a source of inflation, but raised concerns over the sustainability of robust consumer spending and strong economic growth. Wage growth is lagging inflation, and consumers have been saving less and also dipping into their nest eggs to fund purchases.
The smaller and more volatile household survey from which the unemployment rate is calculated showed employment increased by 406,000. That was, however, insufficient to absorb the 485,000 who entered the labor force, lifting the unemployment rate from 4.1% in August. The labor force participation rate rose to 61.8% from 61.6% in August.
More people worked part-time for economic reasons, and long-term unemployment climbed. That raised the median duration of joblessness to near a 4-1/2-year high of 11.5 weeks from 11.4 weeks in August. But a broader measure of unemployment, which includes people who want to work but have given up searching and those working part-time because they cannot find full-time employment, fell to 7.6% from 7.7% in August.
"There is nothing in this report to suggest the jobs market is in real trouble, but its resilience probably isn't on as secure a foundation as GDP growth," said Scott Anderson, chief US economist at BMO Capital Markets.

items.title: US halts consular services in Brazil ahead of election, increasing tensions
items.author: Lisandra Paraguassu, Doina Chiacu
items.creator: Lisandra Paraguassu, Doina Chiacu
items.summary: Citing security concerns, the United States suspended consular services on Friday, prompting Australia to also close its embassy two days before the country's presidential election, fueling an already uneasy environment ahead of the high-stakes vote.
items.body:
Citing security concerns, the United States suspended consular services on Friday, prompting Australia to also close its embassy two days before the country's presidential election, fueling an already uneasy environment ahead of the high-stakes vote.
Brazil's Federal Police said on Friday afternoon they had carried out preventive searches in Sao Paulo and near Brasilia, but had so far found no evidence of a threat or identified any suspects linked to criminal organizations.
The State Department did not elaborate on the security issues or link them to Sunday's election, which has been marked by tensions over alleged foreign interference and strains between Washington and President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva's government.
"We are working closely with our Brazilian counterparts to address the security concerns," a department spokesperson said in an email.
The department did not say when the consular services would resume.
"Consular Services in the US Embassy and Consulates in Brazil will be suspended starting Friday, October 2 due to security concerns," it said in a statement Thursday. "US citizens seeking emergency assistance during this time should not come to the Embassy, the Consulates, or other US diplomatic facilities."
Australia's ambassador to Brazil, Sophie Davies, said on social media that the Australian embassy in Brasilia would also be closed on Friday due to security concerns, citing the alert issued by the US and advising Australians to avoid US embassies and consulates in Brazil.
Brazil's foreign ministry declined to comment on the matter.
ELECTION TENSIONS The State Department made the announcement at a tense moment for US-Brazil relations.
Brazilians will [USN:L6N45K0PD TEXT:"vote"] for president on Sunday in a race that will determine whether Latin America's largest nation follows the conservative shift that US President Donald Trump has often cheered on from Washington.
Lula and his allies [USN:S0N44O041 TEXT:"have warned"] of foreign interference in the election, pointing to [USN:FWN43H1K7 TEXT:"tariffs"] and [USN:L6N43R03C TEXT:"an effort"] by Washington to send officials to Brazil to "discuss electoral integrity."
Edinho Silva, president of Lula's Workers' Party, called Friday's closures "unprecedented" in a press conference.
"It makes no sense at all. It's one of Trump's ways of trying to influence Brazilian public opinion," Silva said.
Though he has publicly praised Lula's main right-wing opponent Senator Flavio Bolsonaro, Trump has not formally endorsed a candidate, and the State Department has rejected claims of election meddling, but the issue has hovered over the race.
Brazilian intelligence officials this month briefed a French and German delegation in Brasilia on what they [USN:L1N45E08V TEXT:"described as US and Russian interference"] before Brazil's election. The visit underlined growing concern on both sides of the Atlantic over Trump's efforts to support like-minded candidates.
Violent crime has also dominated the list of voter concerns in Brazilian election polls, prompting candidates to pledge tougher security measures.

Oct 2 : Standard Chartered expects the European Central Bank to raise its deposit rate by 25 basis points to 2.75 per cent in December, reversing its previous call for a pause, after stronger-than-expected inflation and resilient economic activity reinforced the case for further tightening.
The brokerage changed its forecast after euro zone inflation accelerated more than expected in September, driven largely by higher energy prices, while recent business activity data pointed to a more resilient economy than previously anticipated.
Major Wall Street banks have broadly coalesced around expectations for another ECB rate hike in December.
ECB, along with several other major central banks, raised interest rates last month as policymakers sought to contain inflation risks stemming from higher energy costs and resilient economic growth.

"We think the ECB will opt to take rates slightly into restrictive territory," the brokerage's economists wrote in a note, adding that policymakers may seek insurance against the risk of higher energy prices feeding through to wages and broader price pressures.
The ECB will next meet on October 29, but Standard Chartered said a December rate hike is more likely, as policymakers will then have updated economic forecasts and another round of inflation data, despite limited signs of second-round price pressures.
Money markets are pricing in a roughly 65 per cent probability that the ECB will raise rates by 25 basis points in December, LSEG data showed.

items.title: Dólar marca cuarta alza semanal consecutiva frente al euro
items.author: Chibuike Oguh
items.creator: Chibuike Oguh
items.summary: El dólar anotó el viernes a su cuarto avance semanal seguido ante el euro, apoyado por el elevado retorno de los bonos del Tesoro en medio de una liquidación en los mercados de deuda pública europeos y expectativas de que la Reserva Federal mantenga su postura restrictiva.
items.body:
El dólar anotó el viernes a su cuarto avance semanal seguido ante el euro, apoyado por el elevado retorno de los bonos del Tesoro en medio de una liquidación en los mercados de deuda pública europeos y expectativas de que la Reserva Federal mantenga su postura restrictiva.
* El dólar recortó parte de sus ganancias tras datos que mostraron que el crecimiento del empleo en Estados Unidos en septiembre no alcanzó las expectativas y que la tasa de desempleo subió al 4,2%. El rendimientos de los bonos a 10 años bajó tras el reporte, pero posteriormente avanzó 5,14 puntos básicos, al 5,285%.
* El euro , en tanto, registró su cuarta semana consecutiva de pérdidas frente al dólar, la racha más larga de este tipo desde mediados de mayo de 2025. Cotizó por la tarde en 1,12580 dólares, con un avance del 0,13%.
* El dólar se mantuvo respaldado por los retornos de los bonos del Tesoro que rondan máximos de varias décadas, el aumento de las preocupaciones sobre el panorama fiscal en partes de Europa, y los mayores precios del crudo. El alza de los valores del petróleo ha llevado a algunos inversores a reducir su exposición a las divisas de los principales importadores de energía, como el euro y el yen.
* El índice dólar , que compara al billete verde con una cesta de seis destacadas monedas, restó un 0,1%, a 101,88 unidades, pero registró su tercera ganancia semanal.
* La Fed elevó las tasas y anticipó nuevas subidas en septiembre, y su presidente, Kevin Warsh, reafirmó la independencia de la entidad pese a los repetidos llamados del presidente Donald Trump para que se reduzcan los costos de financiación, lo que llevó a los mercados a apostar con firmeza por un mayor endurecimiento de la política monetaria.
* Los operadores descuentan una probabilidad del 86% de que la Fed mantenga las tasas sin cambios este mes, frente al 36% de la semana anterior, según la herramienta FedWatch de CME Group.
* Los países del G7 acordaron el viernes la liberación de 100 millones de barriles de petróleo y diésel de sus reservas, tras la presión de Estados Unidos que trata de frenar el aumento vertiginoso de los precios por la guerra con Irán.

items.title: EUA suspendem serviços consulares no Brasil por temor com segurança; PF descarta risco
items.author: Lisandra Paraguassu, Eduardo Simões
items.creator: Lisandra Paraguassu, Eduardo Simões
items.summary: A representação diplomática dos Estados Unidos no Brasil anunciou a suspensão dos serviços consulares no país a partir desta sexta-feira citando preocupações não especificadas com a segurança, mas a Polícia Federal brasileira afirmou não ter encontrado elementos que pudessem corroborar as suspeitas levantadas.
items.body:
A representação diplomática dos Estados Unidos no Brasil anunciou a suspensão dos serviços consulares no país a partir desta sexta-feira citando preocupações não especificadas com a segurança, mas a Polícia Federal brasileira afirmou não ter encontrado elementos que pudessem corroborar as suspeitas levantadas.
Em comunicado, a PF disse que cumpriu dois mandados de busca e apreensão em São Paulo e no entorno do Distrito Federal nesta sexta-feira para apurar "suposto planejamento de atos que poderiam colocar em risco instalações diplomáticas dos EUA no Brasil", mas que não foram verificados até o momento "elementos que corroborassem os riscos inicialmente apontados, tampouco identificados quaisquer suspeitos de envolvimento com organizações criminosas".
A embaixada dos EUA anunciou em comunicado na quinta-feira a suspensão da prestação dos serviços consulares e orientou cidadãos norte-americanos a não procurarem a embaixada ou os consulados do país no Brasil. Uma fonte com conhecimento do assunto disse que os funcionários da embaixada norte-americana em Brasília haviam sido orientados a trabalhar de casa nesta sexta devido a uma ameaça. A fonte não deu detalhes sobre a ameaça.
A embaixada da Austrália em Brasília também anunciou seu fechamento após o alerta norte-americano.
"Os serviços consulares da embaixada e dos consulados dos Estados Unidos no Brasil serão suspensos a partir de sexta-feira, 2 de outubro, devido a preocupações com a segurança. Cidadãos norte-americanos que necessitem de assistência emergencial durante esse período não devem se dirigir à embaixada, aos consulados ou a outras instalações diplomáticas dos Estados Unidos. Caso precise de assistência de emergência, entre em contato com o oficial de plantão responsável", disse a embaixada em nota publicada em seu site.
Procurado, o Departamento de Estado dos EUA informou por meio de uma porta-voz que "a Administração (do presidente dos EUA Donald) Trump dá máxima prioridade à segurança e à proteção dos cidadãos americanos. As Embaixadas e Consulados dos Estados Unidos no exterior utilizam regularmente o sistema de mensagens STEP, incluindo alertas, para informar os cidadãos americanos sobre ameaças, eventos e mudanças relevantes no contexto local. Estamos trabalhando em estreita cooperação com nossas contrapartes brasileiras para tratar de questões de segurança".
O Departamento de Estado dos EUA não especificou quando os serviços consulares serão retomados.
A embaixadora da Austrália no Brasil, Sophie Davies, informou nas redes sociais que a embaixada australiana em Brasília também ficaria fechada nesta sexta-feira devido a preocupações com a segurança, citando o alerta emitido pelos EUA.
“Também recomendamos evitar a Embaixada dos EUA, os consulados e outras instalações diplomáticas no Brasil e nas áreas vizinhas”, disse Davies.
As preocupações de segurança envolvendo a representação diplomática dos EUA no Brasil ocorrem a dois dias das eleições gerais no domingo e em meio a temores de tentativa de interferência norte-americana no pleito.
O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), candidato à reeleição, já alertou Trump publicamente mais de uma vez para que Washington não busque interferir no processo eleitoral brasileiro.
Principal adversário de Lula, o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), admirador declarado de Trump, esteve recentemente nos EUA quando se encontrou com o presidente norte-americano.
O ex-deputado federal Eduardo Bolsonaro, seu irmão, está morando nos Estados Unidos e tem feito campanha junto a autoridades norte-americanas pela imposição de sanções a ministros do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF), em particular ao ministro Alexandre de Moraes, relator do processo em que o ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro, pai de Flávio e Eduardo, foi condenado por tentativa de golpe de Estado.
Em entrevista coletiva nesta sexta-feira, o presidente do PT, Edinho Silva, criticou o alerta norte-americano e afirmou se tratar de uma tentativa de interferência na eleição.
“É inédito isso de fecharem embaixadas e consulados na eleição. Não tem o menor sentido. É uma das formas de Trump de tentar influenciar a opinião pública brasileira”, disse.
Autoridades da Agência Brasileira de Inteligência (Abin) [USN:L6N45M0VR TEXT:"informaram"] recentemente uma delegação francesa e alemã em Brasília sobre supostas interferências dos EUA e da Rússia antes das eleições no Brasil. A visita destacou a crescente preocupação em ambos os lados do Atlântico com os esforços de Trump para apoiar candidatos com ideologias semelhantes. Isso também mostra como os alvos potenciais da interferência dos EUA estão agora trocando informações.

items.title: ロシア、軽油輸出規制一部解除も　国内需給緩和なら
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Darya Korsunskaya

[モスクワ ２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Darya Korsunskaya

[モスクワ ２日 ロイター] - ロシアのノバク副首相は２日、議会上院で、ディーゼル（軽油）の生産が国内需要を上回った場合、輸出規制の一部解除を検討すると表明した。国内軽油市場は現在、需給が均衡していると述べた。

ロシアは今週、燃料生産業者を対象とする軽油の輸出禁止措置を１０月末まで延長した。同国は今年夏に輸出を制限し始めるまで、米国に次ぐ世界第２位の軽油輸出国だった。ウクライナによる製油所への攻撃で国内供給が減少したため、国内需要への対応を優先する目的で規制を導入した。

イランとウクライナでの戦争で世界的に燃料供給が制約されている。米国では軽油価格が１ガロン＝６．５０ドルを超えて過去最高水準になっており、中間選挙を控えたトランプ米大統領にとって政治的リスクとなっている。

ノバク氏は「現在、軽油市場は需給が均衡しており、供給は十分だ。数日前に軽油の輸出禁止措置を１０月まで延長したばかりだが、引き続き状況を注視し、生産が国内需要を上回れば、輸出の一部再開を検討する」と述べた。

ウクライナによるロシアのエネルギーインフラへのドローン攻撃を巡る状況は、引き続き「緊迫」しているとしたが、防護措置により、度重なる攻撃による被害は大幅に減少していると説明。「これにより、損傷した設備の復旧と、修理後の施設の操業再開をより迅速に進められる」と述べた。

プーチン大統領は１日、対ロシア制裁が解除されるまで、世界のエネルギー市場に軽油を供給しないと述べた。

items.author: ロイター

items.summary: [ロンドン ２日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ロンドン ２日 ロイター] - 自動車団体ＲＡＣがまとめたデータによると、英国の軽油の平均店頭価格が２日、１リットル＝２００．０１ペンスとなり、初めて２ポンド（２．６４ドル）に達した。

これまでの最高値はロシアによるウクライナ侵攻直後の２０２２年６月に記録した１９９．０９ペンスだった。この水準を９月２８日に上回った後も軽油価格はじりじりと上昇を続けている。

ＲＡＣの政策責任者サイモン・ウィリアムズ氏は、価格上昇について「鈍化の兆しは見られない」と述べた。
